title.zh: 卷一百三十三 列傳第八十三: 李晟
title.raw: 卷一百三十三 列傳第八十三: 李晟 Volume 133 Biographies 83: Li Sheng

meta.sourceNote: Body restored from Wikisource juan 133 to match the ChineseNotes chapter heading. The previous Wikisource import used the file number instead of the traditional juan.

sentences.zh: 李晟，字良器，隴右臨洮人。

translations.literal: Li Sheng, styled Liangqi, was a native of Lintao in Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng, whose courtesy name was Liangqi, was a native of Lintao in Longyou.

sentences.zh: 祖思恭，父欽，代居隴右為裨將。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Sigong; his father was Qin. For generations the family dwelt in Longyou as deputy generals.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Sigong and his father Qin. For generations the family had lived in Longyou as deputy generals.

sentences.zh: 晟生數歲而孤，事母孝謹，性雄烈，有才，善騎射。

translations.literal: Sheng lost his father when only a few years old. He served his mother with filial care, was by nature bold and fierce, possessed talent, and excelled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was orphaned at a young age. He served his mother with filial devotion, was bold and fierce by nature, possessed real ability, and excelled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 年十八從軍，身長六尺，勇敢絕倫。

translations.literal: At eighteen he joined the army. He stood six feet tall, and his courage was unmatched.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen he entered military service. He stood six feet tall, and his courage was unmatched.

sentences.zh: 時河西節度使王忠嗣擊吐蕃，有驍將乘城拒鬥，頗傷士卒，忠嗣募軍中能射者射之。

translations.literal: At the time the Hexi military governor Wang Zhongsi was attacking the Tibetans. A fierce enemy general fought from atop the walls and wounded many soldiers. Zhongsi recruited the best archers in the army to shoot him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Hexi military governor Wang Zhongsi was fighting the Tibetans. A fierce enemy general fought from atop the walls and wounded many soldiers, so Zhongsi recruited the army's best archers to bring him down.

sentences.zh: 晟引弓一發而斃，三軍皆大呼，忠嗣厚賞之，因撫其背曰：「此萬人敵也。」

translations.literal: Sheng drew his bow and felled the man with a single shot. The whole army shouted in acclaim. Zhongsi rewarded him generously and, patting his back, said: "Here is a match for ten thousand men."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng drew his bow and dropped the man with a single shot. The whole army roared in acclaim. Zhongsi rewarded him generously and, patting his back, said, "Here is a match for ten thousand men."

sentences.zh: 鳳翔節度使高升雅聞其名，召補列將。

translations.literal: Gao Shengya, military governor of Fengxiang, heard of his fame and summoned him to fill a post as a ranked commander.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shengya, military governor of Fengxiang, heard of his reputation and summoned him to serve as a ranked commander.

sentences.zh: 嘗擊疊州叛羌於高當川，又擊宕州連狂羌於罕山，皆破之，累遷左羽林大將軍同正。

translations.literal: He once attacked rebellious Qiang at Gaodang River in Die Prefecture, and again attacked the Lian-kuang Qiang of Dang Prefecture at Han Mountain; he defeated them both and was repeatedly promoted to Senior General of the Left Imperial Guard with concurrent appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He once attacked rebellious Qiang at Gaodang River in Die Prefecture and again defeated the Lian-kuang Qiang of Dang Prefecture at Han Mountain. After both victories he was repeatedly promoted, eventually reaching Senior General of the Left Imperial Guard with concurrent appointment.

sentences.zh: 廣德初，鳳翔節度使孫誌直署晟總遊兵，擊破党項羌高玉等，以功授特進、試光祿卿，轉試太常卿。

translations.literal: In the early Guangde era, Sun Zhizhi, military governor of Fengxiang, appointed Sheng to command mobile troops. He defeated the Tangut chieftain Gao Yu and others, and for this merit was granted Special Grand Master and Acting Director of the Imperial Household, then transferred to Acting Minister of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangde era, Sun Zhizhi, military governor of Fengxiang, put Sheng in command of mobile troops. He defeated the Tangut chieftain Gao Yu and others, and for this service was granted Special Grand Master and Acting Director of the Imperial Household, then transferred to Acting Minister of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 大歷初，李抱玉鎮鳳翔，署晟為右軍都將。

translations.literal: Early in the Dali era, Li Baoyu governed Fengxiang and appointed Sheng Right Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Dali era, when Li Baoyu governed Fengxiang, he appointed Sheng Right Army Commander.

sentences.zh: 四年，吐蕃圍靈州，抱玉遣晟將兵五千以擊吐蕃，晟辭曰：「以眾則不足，以謀則太多。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Tibetans besieged Ling Prefecture. Baoyu sent Sheng with five thousand men to strike the Tibetans. Sheng declined, saying: "For numbers we are too few; for strategy we are too many."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Tibetans besieged Ling Prefecture. Baoyu sent Sheng with five thousand men to attack them. Sheng declined, saying, "By numbers we are too few; by strategy we are too many."

sentences.zh: 乃請將兵千人疾出大震關，至臨洮，屠定秦堡，焚其積聚，虜堡帥慕容谷鐘而還，吐蕃因解靈州之圍而去。

translations.literal: He then asked to lead a thousand men in a rapid march out through Dazhen Pass to Lintao, where he slaughtered the garrison of Dingqin Fort, burned its stores, captured the fort commander Murong Guzhong, and returned. The Tibetans thereupon lifted the siege of Ling and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He then asked to lead a thousand men in a rapid march through Dazhen Pass to Lintao, where he slaughtered the garrison of Dingqin Fort, burned its stores, captured the fort commander Murong Guzhong, and returned. The Tibetans thereupon lifted the siege of Ling Prefecture and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 拜開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand General with the Ceremonial of the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand General with the Ceremonial of the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 無幾，兼左金吾衛大將軍、涇原四鎮北庭都知兵馬使，並總遊兵。

translations.literal: Before long he was also made Senior General of the Left Golden Guard and Commander-in-Chief of the Four Garrisons and Beiting of Jingyuan, while still commanding mobile troops.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was also made Senior General of the Left Golden Guard and Commander-in-Chief of the Four Garrisons and Beiting of Jingyuan, while continuing to command mobile troops.

sentences.zh: 無何，節度使馬璘與吐蕃戰於鹽倉，兵敗，晟率所部橫擊之，拔璘出亂兵之中，以功封合川郡王。

translations.literal: Soon after, the military governor Ma Lin fought the Tibetans at Yancang and was defeated. Sheng led his command in a flanking attack, pulled Lin out of the chaos, and for this merit was enfeoffed as Prince of Hechuan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, Military Governor Ma Lin fought the Tibetans at Yancang and was defeated. Sheng led his command in a flanking attack, pulled Lin out of the chaos, and for this service was enfeoffed as Prince of Hechuan.

sentences.zh: 璘忌晟威名，又遇之不以禮，令朝京師，代宗留居宿衛，為右神策都將。

translations.literal: Lin resented Sheng's renown and also failed to treat him with courtesy. He ordered him to proceed to the capital. Emperor Daizong kept him in palace guard service as Right Commander of the Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: Lin resented Sheng's renown and also treated him without courtesy. He ordered him to proceed to the capital. Emperor Daizong kept him in palace guard service as Right Commander of the Divine Strategy Army.

sentences.zh: 德宗即位，吐蕃寇劍南，時節度使崔寧朝京師，三川震恐，乃詔晟將神策兵救之，授太子賓客。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong took the throne, the Tibetans raided Jiannan. The military governor Cui Ning was then at the capital, and the Three Rivers region was shaken with fear. An edict ordered Sheng to lead the Divine Strategy Army to the rescue and appointed him Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong took the throne, the Tibetans raided Jiannan. Military Governor Cui Ning was then at the capital, and the Three Rivers region was shaken with fear. An edict ordered Sheng to lead the Divine Strategy Army to the rescue and appointed him Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 晟乃逾漏天，拔飛越，廓清肅寧三城，絕大渡河，獲首虜千余級，虜乃引退，因留成都數月而還。

translations.literal: Sheng crossed Loutian, captured Feiyue, cleared the three cities of Su and Ning, crossed the Dadu River, and took more than a thousand enemy heads. The barbarians then withdrew. He remained at Chengdu several months before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng crossed Loutian, captured Feiyue, cleared the three cities of Su and Ning, crossed the Dadu River, and took more than a thousand enemy heads. The barbarians then withdrew. He remained at Chengdu for several months before returning.

sentences.zh: 建中二年，魏博田悅反，將兵圍臨洺、邢州，詔以晟為神策先鋒都知兵馬使，與河東節度使馬燧、昭義節度使李抱真合兵救臨洺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianzhong, Tian Yue of Weibo rebelled and led troops to besiege Linzhang and Xing Prefecture. An edict appointed Sheng Commander-in-Chief of the Divine Strategy Vanguard and ordered him to join Military Governor Ma Sui of Hedong and Military Governor Li Baozhen of Zhaoyi in relieving Linzhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianzhong, Tian Yue of Weibo rebelled and led troops to besiege Linzhang and Xing Prefecture. An edict appointed Sheng Commander-in-Chief of the Divine Strategy Vanguard and ordered him to join Military Governor Ma Sui of Hedong and Military Governor Li Baozhen of Zhaoyi in relieving Linzhang.

sentences.zh: 尋加兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: Soon he was also made Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was also made Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 河東、昭義軍攻楊朝光於臨洺南，晟與河東騎將李自良、李奉國擊悅於雙岡，悅兵卻，遂斬朝光。

translations.literal: The Hedong and Zhaoyi armies attacked Yang Chaoguang south of Linzhang. Sheng, with the Hedong cavalry commanders Li Ziliang and Li Fengguo, struck Yue at Shuanggang. Yue's troops fell back, and Chaoguang was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The Hedong and Zhaoyi armies attacked Yang Chaoguang south of Linzhang. Sheng, with the Hedong cavalry commanders Li Ziliang and Li Fengguo, struck Yue at Shuanggang. Yue's troops fell back, and Chaoguang was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 戰於臨洺，諸軍皆卻。

translations.literal: In the fighting at Linzhang, all the armies fell back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fighting at Linzhang, all the armies fell back.

sentences.zh: 晟引兵渡洺水，乘冰而濟，橫擊悅軍，王師復振，擊悅，大破之。

translations.literal: Sheng led his troops across the Zhang River, crossed on the ice, struck Yue's army from the flank, and the imperial forces rallied. He attacked Yue and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng led his troops across the Zhang River, crossed on the ice, struck Yue's army from the flank, and the imperial forces rallied. He attacked Yue and routed him.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，復以諸道軍擊敗悅軍於洹水，遂進攻魏州，以功加檢校左散騎常侍，實封百戶。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, the allied armies again defeated Yue's forces at the Huan River and advanced to attack Weizhou. For this merit Sheng was made Acting Left Regular Attendant and granted a substantive fief of one hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, the allied armies again defeated Yue's forces at the Huan River and advanced to attack Weizhou. For this merit Sheng was made Acting Left Regular Attendant and granted a substantive fief of one hundred households.

sentences.zh: 無幾，兼魏府左司馬。

translations.literal: Before long he was also made Left Administrator of the Weifu.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was also made Left Administrator of the Weifu.

sentences.zh: 時硃滔、王武俊聯兵在深、趙，怒朝廷賞功薄，田悅知其可間，遣使求援，滔與武俊應之，遂以兵圍康日知於趙州。

translations.literal: At the time Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun had joined forces in Shen and Zhao, angry that the court's rewards for merit were meager. Tian Yue knew they could be divided and sent envoys to seek aid. Tao and Wujun responded and led troops to besiege Kang Rizhi at Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun had joined forces in Shen and Zhao, angry that the court's rewards for merit were meager. Tian Yue knew they could be divided and sent envoys to seek aid. Tao and Wujun responded and led troops to besiege Kang Rizhi at Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 李抱真分兵二千人守邢州，馬燧大怒，欲班師。

translations.literal: Li Baozhen detached two thousand men to guard Xing Prefecture. Ma Sui was greatly angered and wished to withdraw his army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Baozhen detached two thousand men to guard Xing Prefecture. Ma Sui was greatly angered and wished to withdraw his army.

sentences.zh: 晟謂燧曰：「初奉詔進討，三帥齊進。

translations.literal: Sheng said to Sui: "At first we received the edict to advance and attack, and the three commanders moved together.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said to Sui, "At first we received the edict to advance and attack, and the three commanders moved together.

sentences.zh: 李尚書以邢州與趙州接圵，分兵守之，誠未為害，其精卒銳將皆在於此，令公遽自引去，奈王事何？」

translations.literal: Minister Li posted troops at Xing Prefecture because it borders Zhao Prefecture; that was no real harm. His elite soldiers and sharp commanders are all here. If you now suddenly withdraw on your own, what will become of the state's business?"
translations.idiomatic: Minister Li posted troops at Xing Prefecture because it borders Zhao Prefecture; that was no real harm. His elite soldiers and sharp commanders are all here. If you now suddenly withdraw on your own, what will become of the state's business?"

sentences.zh: 燧釋然謝晟，燧乃自造抱真壘，與之交歡如初。

translations.literal: Sui was relieved and apologized to Sheng. He then went in person to Baozhen's camp and renewed their friendship as before.
translations.idiomatic: Sui was relieved and apologized to Sheng. He then went in person to Baozhen's camp and renewed their friendship as before.

sentences.zh: 王武俊攻趙州，晟乃獻狀請解趙州之圍，欲引兵赴定州與張孝忠合勢，欲圖范陽，德宗壯之，加晟御史大夫，俾禁軍將軍莫仁擢、趙光銑、杜季泚皆隸焉。

translations.literal: Wang Wujun attacked Zhao Prefecture. Sheng submitted a memorial asking to lift the siege of Zhao and to lead his army to Ding Prefecture to join forces with Zhang Xiaozhong, intending to strike at Fanyang. Dezong admired this and made Sheng Censor-in-Chief, with the palace guard generals Mo Renzhuo, Zhao Guangxian, and Du Jichou all placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wujun attacked Zhao Prefecture. Sheng submitted a memorial asking to lift the siege of Zhao and to lead his army to Ding Prefecture to join forces with Zhang Xiaozhong, intending to strike at Fanyang. Dezong admired this and made Sheng Censor-in-Chief, with the palace guard generals Mo Renzhuo, Zhao Guangxian, and Du Jichou all placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 晟自魏州引軍而北，徑趨趙州，武俊聞之，解圍而去。

translations.literal: Sheng led his army north from Weizhou and marched straight for Zhao Prefecture. When Wujun heard of it, he lifted the siege and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng led his army north from Weizhou and marched straight for Zhao Prefecture. When Wujun heard of it, he lifted the siege and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 晟留趙州三日，與孝忠兵合，北略恆州，圍硃滔將鄭景濟於清苑，決水以灌之。

translations.literal: Sheng remained at Zhao Prefecture three days, then joined Xiaozhong's forces and advanced north through Heng Prefecture, besieging Zhu Tao's general Zheng Jingji at Qingyuan and breaching the dikes to flood the city.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng remained at Zhao Prefecture three days, then joined Xiaozhong's forces and advanced north through Heng Prefecture, besieging Zhu Tao's general Zheng Jingji at Qingyuan and breaching the dikes to flood the city.

sentences.zh: 田悅、王武俊皆遣兵來救，戰於白樓。

translations.literal: Tian Yue and Wang Wujun both sent troops to the rescue, and battle was joined at Bailou.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Yue and Wang Wujun both sent troops to the rescue, and battle was joined at Bailou.

sentences.zh: 賊犯義武軍，稍卻，晟引步騎擊破之，晟所乘馬連中流矢。

translations.literal: The rebels attacked the Yiwu Army and were driven back slightly. Sheng led infantry and cavalry in a crushing attack. The horse Sheng rode was struck by arrows in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels attacked the Yiwu Army and were driven back slightly. Sheng led infantry and cavalry in a crushing attack. The horse Sheng rode was struck by arrows in succession.

sentences.zh: 逾月，城中益急，滔、武俊大懼，乃悉收魏博之眾而來，復圍晟軍。

translations.literal: After more than a month the city grew more desperate. Tao and Wujun were greatly afraid and gathered all the Weibo troops, then came again and encircled Sheng's army.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month the city grew more desperate. Tao and Wujun were greatly afraid and gathered all the Weibo troops, then came again and encircled Sheng's army.

sentences.zh: 晟內圍景濟，外與滔等拒戰，日數合，自正月至於五月。

translations.literal: Within, Sheng besieged Jingji; outside, he fought Tao and the others. Battle joined several times a day from the first month until the fifth.
translations.idiomatic: Within, Sheng besieged Jingji; outside, he fought Tao and the others. Battle joined several times a day from the first month until the fifth.

sentences.zh: 會晟病甚，不知人者數焉。

translations.literal: Then Sheng fell gravely ill and was unconscious several times.
translations.idiomatic: Then Sheng fell gravely ill and was unconscious several times.

sentences.zh: 軍吏合謀，乃以馬輿還定州，賊不敢逼。

translations.literal: The staff officers conspired together and carried him in a litter back to Ding Prefecture. The rebels did not dare press close.
translations.idiomatic: The staff officers conspired together and carried him in a litter back to Ding Prefecture. The rebels did not dare press close.

sentences.zh: 晟疾間，復將進師，會京城變起，德宗在奉天，詔晟赴難。

translations.literal: When Sheng's illness eased, he prepared to advance again. Then turmoil broke out in the capital, Dezong was at Fengtian, and an edict summoned Sheng to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng's illness eased, he prepared to advance again. Then turmoil broke out in the capital, Dezong was at Fengtian, and an edict summoned Sheng to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 晟承詔泣下，即日欲赴關輔。

translations.literal: Sheng received the edict and wept. That very day he wished to hurry to Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng received the edict and wept. That very day he wished to hurry to Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 義武軍間於硃滔、王武俊，倚晟為輕重，不欲晟去，數謀沮止晟軍。

translations.literal: The Yiwu Army, caught between Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun, relied on Sheng for its weight in the balance and did not wish him to leave. Several times they plotted to obstruct his march.
translations.idiomatic: The Yiwu Army, caught between Zhu Tao and Wang Wujun, relied on Sheng for its weight in the balance and did not wish him to leave. Several times they plotted to obstruct his march.

sentences.zh: 晟謂將吏曰：「天子播越於外，人臣當百舍一息，死而後已。

translations.literal: Sheng said to his commanders and officials: "The Son of Heaven is cast into exile. As his subjects we should travel a hundred lodges with but one breath between them and die only when we can die no more.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said to his commanders and officials, "The Son of Heaven is cast into exile. As his subjects we should travel a hundred lodges with but one breath between them and die only when we can die no more.

sentences.zh: 張義武欲沮吾行，吾當以愛子為質，選良馬以啖其意。」

translations.literal: Zhang of Yiwu wishes to obstruct my march. I shall leave my beloved son as a hostage and select fine horses to satisfy his desire."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang of Yiwu wishes to obstruct my march. I shall leave my beloved son as a hostage and select fine horses to satisfy his desire."

sentences.zh: 乃留子憑以為婚。

translations.literal: He then left his son Ping as a pledge in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: He then left his son Ping as a pledge in marriage.

sentences.zh: 義武軍有大將為孝忠委信者謁晟，晟乃解玉帶以遺之，因曰：「吾欲西行，願以為別。」

translations.literal: A senior general of the Yiwu Army whom Xiaozhong trusted came to see Sheng. Sheng removed his jade belt and gave it to him, saying: "I wish to march west. Let this be my parting gift."
translations.idiomatic: A senior general of the Yiwu Army whom Xiaozhong trusted came to see Sheng. Sheng removed his jade belt and gave it to him, saying, "I wish to march west. Let this be my parting gift."

sentences.zh: 陳赴難之意，受帶者果德晟，乃諫孝忠勿止晟。

translations.literal: He expressed his intent to go to the rescue. The man who received the belt was indeed grateful to Sheng and urged Xiaozhong not to stop him.
translations.idiomatic: He expressed his intent to go to the rescue. The man who received the belt was indeed grateful to Sheng and urged Xiaozhong not to stop him.

sentences.zh: 晟得引軍逾飛狐，師次代州，詔加晟檢校工部尚書、神策行營節度使，實封二百戶。

translations.literal: Sheng was able to lead his army across Feihu Pass. When his troops halted at Dai Prefecture, an edict added to his titles Acting Minister of Works and Military Governor of the Divine Strategy Field Army, with a substantive fief increased by two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was able to lead his army across Feihu Pass. When his troops halted at Dai Prefecture, an edict added to his titles Acting Minister of Works and Military Governor of the Divine Strategy Field Army, with a substantive fief increased by two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 晟軍令嚴肅，所過樵采無犯。

translations.literal: Sheng's military discipline was severe. Where his army passed, none violated firewood or forage.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng's military discipline was severe. Where his army passed, none violated firewood or forage.

sentences.zh: 自河中由蒲津而軍渭北，壁東渭橋以逼泚。

translations.literal: From Hezhong he crossed the Pu Ford and encamped on the north bank of the Wei, building fortifications at East Wei Bridge to press Zhu Ci.
translations.idiomatic: From Hezhong he crossed the Pu Ford and encamped on the north bank of the Wei, building fortifications at East Wei Bridge to press Zhu Ci.

sentences.zh: 時劉德信將子弟軍救襄城，敗於扈澗，聞難，率余軍先次渭南，與晟合軍。

translations.literal: At the time Liu Dexin was leading the Sons' Army to relieve Xiangcheng and had been defeated at Hujian. Hearing of the crisis, he led the remnant force first to Weinan and joined Sheng's army.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Liu Dexin was leading the Sons' Army to relieve Xiangcheng and had been defeated at Hujian. Hearing of the crisis, he led the remnant force first to Weinan and joined Sheng's army.

sentences.zh: 軍無統一，晟不能制，因德信入晟軍，乃數其罪斬之。

translations.literal: The army had no unified command, and Sheng could not control it. When Dexin entered Sheng's camp, Sheng enumerated his crimes and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: The army had no unified command, and Sheng could not control it. When Dexin entered Sheng's camp, Sheng enumerated his crimes and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 晟以數騎馳入德信軍，撫勞其眾，無敢動者。

translations.literal: Sheng rode with a few horsemen into Dexin's army, comforted the troops, and none dared stir.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng rode with a few horsemen into Dexin's army, comforted the troops, and none dared stir.

sentences.zh: 既併德信軍，軍益振。

translations.literal: Once Dexin's army was merged, Sheng's force grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Once Dexin's army was merged, Sheng's force grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 時朔方節度使李懷光亦自河北赴難，軍於咸陽，不欲晟獨當一面以分己功，乃奏請與晟兵合，乃詔晟移軍合懷光軍。

translations.literal: At the time Li Huaiguang, military governor of Shuofang, also came from Hebei to the rescue and encamped at Xianyang. He did not wish Sheng alone to hold one front and divide his own merit, and memorialized asking that their armies be combined. An edict then ordered Sheng to move his army and join Huaiguang.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Li Huaiguang, military governor of Shuofang, also came from Hebei to the rescue and encamped at Xianyang. He did not wish Sheng alone to hold one front and divide his own merit, and memorialized asking that their armies be combined. An edict then ordered Sheng to move his army and join Huaiguang.

sentences.zh: 晟奉詔引軍至陳濤斜，軍壘未成，賊兵遽至，晟乃出陣，且言於懷光曰：「賊堅保宮苑，攻之未必克；

translations.literal: Sheng received the edict and led his army to Chentao Slope. Before the camp fortifications were finished, rebel troops arrived at once. Sheng deployed for battle and said to Huaiguang: "The rebels hold the palace parks in a firm defense; an attack may not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng received the edict and led his army to Chentao Slope. Before the camp fortifications were finished, rebel troops arrived at once. Sheng deployed for battle and said to Huaiguang, "The rebels hold the palace parks in a firm defense; an attack may not succeed.

sentences.zh: 今離其窟穴，敢出索戰，此殆天以賊賜明公也！」

translations.literal: Now they have left their lair and dare come out seeking battle. Heaven is nearly giving the rebels to the enlightened lord!"
translations.idiomatic: Now they have left their lair and dare come out seeking battle. Heaven is nearly giving the rebels to the enlightened lord!"

sentences.zh: 懷光恐晟立功，乃曰：「召軍適至，馬未秣，士未飯，詎可戰耶？

translations.literal: Huaiguang feared Sheng would win merit and said: "The summoned army has only just arrived. The horses are unfed and the men unfed. How can we fight?
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang feared Sheng would win merit and said, "The summoned army has only just arrived. The horses are unfed and the men unfed. How can we fight?

sentences.zh: 不如蓄銳養威，俟時而舉。」

translations.literal: Better to store up sharpness and nurture might, and strike when the time is ripe."
translations.idiomatic: Better to store up sharpness and nurture might, and strike when the time is ripe."

sentences.zh: 晟知其意，遂收軍入壘，時興元元年正月也。

translations.literal: Sheng knew his intent and withdrew the army into camp. It was the first month of the first year of Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng knew his intent and withdrew the army into camp. It was the first month of the first year of Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 每將合戰，必自異，衣錦裘、繡帽前行，親自指導。

translations.literal: Whenever battle was about to join, he always distinguished himself, wearing a brocade fur coat and embroidered cap as he advanced in person to direct the fight.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever battle was about to join, he always distinguished himself, wearing a brocade fur coat and embroidered cap as he advanced in person to direct the fight.

sentences.zh: 懷光望見惡之，乃謂晟曰：「將帥當持重，豈宜自表飾以啖賊也！」

translations.literal: Huaiguang saw this and hated it. He said to Sheng: "A commander should be grave and steady. How can he adorn himself to bait the enemy!"
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang saw this and hated it. He said to Sheng, "A commander should be grave and steady. How can he adorn himself to bait the enemy!"

sentences.zh: 晟曰：「晟久在涇原，軍士頗相畏服，故欲令其先識以奪其心耳。」

translations.literal: Sheng said: "Sheng has long been in Jingyuan, and the soldiers are quite in awe of him. I wished them to recognize me first and so seize their hearts."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said, "I have long been in Jingyuan, and the soldiers are quite in awe of me. I wished them to recognize me first and so seize their hearts."

sentences.zh: 懷光益不悅，陰有異志，遷延不進。

translations.literal: Huaiguang grew still more displeased, harbored a different intent in secret, and delayed without advancing.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang grew still more displeased, harbored a different intent in secret, and delayed without advancing.

sentences.zh: 晟因人說懷光曰：「寇賊竊據京邑，天子出居近甸，兵柄廟略，屬在明公。

translations.literal: Sheng had someone persuade Huaiguang: "Bandits and rebels have seized the capital. The Son of Heaven dwells in the nearby suburbs. Military authority and the court's strategy rest with the enlightened lord.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng had someone persuade Huaiguang, "Bandits and rebels have seized the capital. The Son of Heaven dwells in the nearby suburbs. Military authority and the court's strategy rest with the enlightened lord.

sentences.zh: 公宜觀兵速進，晟願以所部得奉嚴令，為公前驅，雖死不悔。」

translations.literal: You should display your army and advance swiftly. Sheng wishes to lead his command under your strict orders as your vanguard, and though I die I shall not regret it."
translations.idiomatic: You should display your army and advance swiftly. I wish to lead my command under your strict orders as your vanguard, and though I die I shall not regret it."

sentences.zh: 懷光益拒之。

translations.literal: Huaiguang refused all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang refused all the more.

sentences.zh: 晟兵軍於朔方軍北，每晟與懷光同至城下，懷光軍輒虜驅牛馬，吾姓苦之；

translations.literal: Sheng's army encamped north of the Shuofang army. Whenever Sheng and Huaiguang went together to the foot of the walls, Huaiguang's troops would seize and drive off cattle and horses, and the common people suffered bitterly.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng's army encamped north of the Shuofang army. Whenever Sheng and Huaiguang went together to the foot of the walls, Huaiguang's troops would seize and drive off cattle and horses, and the common people suffered bitterly.

sentences.zh: 晟軍無所犯。

translations.literal: Sheng's army committed no violations.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng's army committed no violations.

sentences.zh: 懷光軍惡其獨善，乃分所獲與之，晟軍不敢受。

translations.literal: Huaiguang's army hated that he alone kept his conduct pure and divided the spoils with him. Sheng's troops dared not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang's army hated that he alone kept his conduct pure and divided the spoils with him. Sheng's troops dared not accept them.

sentences.zh: 久之，懷光將謀沮晟軍，計未有所出。

translations.literal: After a long while Huaiguang plotted to obstruct Sheng's army, but no plan had yet emerged.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while Huaiguang plotted to obstruct Sheng's army, but no plan had yet emerged.

sentences.zh: 時神策軍以舊例給賜厚於諸軍，懷光奏曰：「賊寇未平，軍中給賜，咸宜均一。

translations.literal: At the time, by old precedent the Divine Strategy Army received richer grants than the other armies. Huaiguang memorialized: "The bandits are not yet pacified. Grants within the army should all be equal.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, by old precedent the Divine Strategy Army received richer grants than the other armies. Huaiguang memorialized, "The bandits are not yet pacified. Grants within the army should all be equal.

sentences.zh: 今神策獨厚，諸軍皆以為言，臣無以止之，惟陛下裁處。」

translations.literal: Now the Divine Strategy Army alone is favored. All the armies speak of it. I have no way to stop them. I ask only that Your Majesty decide."
translations.idiomatic: Now the Divine Strategy Army alone is favored. All the armies speak of it. I have no way to stop them. I ask only that Your Majesty decide."

sentences.zh: 懷光計欲因是令晟自署侵削己軍，以撓破之。

translations.literal: Huaiguang intended by this to make Sheng himself order cuts to his own army and so break it.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang intended by this to make Sheng himself order cuts to his own army and so break it.

sentences.zh: 德宗憂之，欲以諸軍同神策，則財賦不給，無可奈何，乃遣翰林學士陸贄往懷光軍宣諭，仍令懷光與晟參議所宜以聞。

translations.literal: Dezong was troubled. He wished to make all armies equal to the Divine Strategy Army, but the treasury could not supply it and he was helpless. He sent Hanlin Academician Lu Zhi to Huaiguang's army to proclaim the imperial will and ordered Huaiguang and Sheng to consult on what should be done and report.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong was troubled. He wished to make all armies equal to the Divine Strategy Army, but the treasury could not supply it and he was helpless. He sent Hanlin Academician Lu Zhi to Huaiguang's army to proclaim the imperial will and ordered Huaiguang and Sheng to consult on what should be done and report.

sentences.zh: 贄、晟俱會於懷光軍，懷光言曰：「軍士稟賜不均，何以令戰？」

translations.literal: Zhi and Sheng both met in Huaiguang's army. Huaiguang said: "Soldiers' rations and grants are unequal. How can they be ordered to fight?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhi and Sheng both met in Huaiguang's army. Huaiguang said, "Soldiers' rations and grants are unequal. How can they be ordered to fight?"

sentences.zh: 贄未有言，數顧晟。

translations.literal: Zhi had not yet spoken and repeatedly looked at Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi had not yet spoken and repeatedly looked at Sheng.

sentences.zh: 晟曰：「公為元帥，弛張號令，皆得專之。

translations.literal: Sheng said: "You are commander-in-chief. In loosening and tightening, in issuing orders, you have full authority.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said, "You are commander-in-chief. In loosening and tightening, in issuing orders, you have full authority.

sentences.zh: 晟當將一軍，唯公所指，以效死命。

translations.literal: Sheng will lead one army wherever you point, to give his life in service.
translations.idiomatic: I will lead one army wherever you point, to give my life in service.

sentences.zh: 至於增損衣食，公當裁之。」

translations.literal: As for increasing or reducing food and clothing, you should decide."
translations.idiomatic: As for increasing or reducing food and clothing, you should decide."

sentences.zh: 懷光默然，無以難晟，又不欲侵刻神策軍發於自己，乃止。

translations.literal: Huaiguang was silent and had no way to press Sheng. He also did not wish to cut the Divine Strategy Army himself, and so stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang was silent and had no way to press Sheng. He also did not wish to cut the Divine Strategy Army himself, and so stopped.

sentences.zh: 懷光屯咸陽，堅壁八十余日，不肯出軍，德宗憂之，屢降中使，促以收復之期。

translations.literal: Huaiguang encamped at Xianyang behind stout walls for more than eighty days and would not advance. Dezong was troubled and repeatedly sent palace envoys to press for a date of recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang encamped at Xianyang behind stout walls for more than eighty days and would not advance. Dezong was troubled and repeatedly sent palace envoys to press for a date of recovery.

sentences.zh: 懷光托以卒疲，更請休息，以伺其便，然陰與硃泚交通，其跡漸露。

translations.literal: Huaiguang pleaded that the troops were exhausted and asked again for rest, waiting for a convenient moment. Yet in secret he communicated with Zhu Ci, and his tracks gradually showed.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang pleaded that the troops were exhausted and asked again for rest, waiting for a convenient moment. Yet in secret he communicated with Zhu Ci, and his tracks gradually showed.

sentences.zh: 晟懼為所併，乃密疏請移軍東渭橋，以分賊勢。

translations.literal: Sheng feared being absorbed and secretly memorialized asking to move his army to East Wei Bridge to divide the rebels' strength.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng feared being absorbed and secretly memorialized asking to move his army to East Wei Bridge to divide the rebels' strength.

sentences.zh: 上初未之許。

translations.literal: At first the emperor did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: At first the emperor did not grant it.

sentences.zh: 晟以懷光反狀已明，緩急宜有所備。

translations.literal: Sheng judged that Huaiguang's rebellion was already clear and that in urgency or ease there should be preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng judged that Huaiguang's rebellion was already clear and that in urgency or ease there should be preparations.

sentences.zh: 蜀、漢之路，不可壅也，請以裨將趙光銑為洋州刺史，唐良臣為利州刺史，晟子婿張彧為劍州刺史，各將兵五百以防未然。

translations.literal: The roads to Shu and Han could not be blocked. He asked that Deputy General Zhao Guangxian be made Prefect of Yang, Tang Liangchen Prefect of Li, and Sheng's son-in-law Zhang Yu Prefect of Jian, each leading five hundred men against what might come.
translations.idiomatic: The roads to Shu and Han could not be blocked. He asked that Deputy General Zhao Guangxian be made Prefect of Yang, Tang Liangchen Prefect of Li, and Sheng's son-in-law Zhang Yu Prefect of Jian, each leading five hundred men against what might come.

sentences.zh: 上初納之，未果行。

translations.literal: At first the emperor accepted it, but it was not yet carried out.
translations.idiomatic: At first the emperor accepted it, but it was not yet carried out.

sentences.zh: 無何，吐蕃請以兵佐誅泚，上欲親總六師，移幸咸陽，以促諸軍進討。

translations.literal: Before long the Tibetans asked to send troops to help destroy Zhu Ci. The emperor wished to lead the Six Armies in person and move to Xianyang to urge the armies forward.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Tibetans asked to send troops to help destroy Zhu Ci. The emperor wished to lead the Six Armies in person and move to Xianyang to urge the armies forward.

sentences.zh: 懷光聞之大駭，疑上奪其軍，謀亂益急。

translations.literal: Huaiguang heard this and was greatly alarmed, suspecting the emperor meant to seize his army. His plot for rebellion grew more urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang heard this and was greatly alarmed, suspecting the emperor meant to seize his army. His plot for rebellion grew more urgent.

sentences.zh: 時鄜坊節度李建徽、神策將楊惠元及晟，並與懷光聯營，晟以事迫，會有中使過晟軍，晟乃宣令云：「奉詔徙屯渭橋。」

translations.literal: At the time Military Governor Li Jianhui of Zhenfang, Divine Strategy General Yang Huiyuan, and Sheng were all encamped with Huaiguang. The matter was pressing. A palace envoy happened to pass Sheng's army, and Sheng proclaimed the order: "By edict, move and encamp at Wei Bridge."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Military Governor Li Jianhui of Zhenfang, Divine Strategy General Yang Huiyuan, and Sheng were all encamped with Huaiguang. The matter was pressing. A palace envoy happened to pass Sheng's army, and Sheng proclaimed the order, "By edict, move and encamp at Wei Bridge."

sentences.zh: 乃結陣而行，至渭橋。

translations.literal: He then formed ranks and marched to Wei Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: He then formed ranks and marched to Wei Bridge.

sentences.zh: 不數日，懷光果劫建徽、惠元而併其兵，建徽遁免，惠元為懷光所害。

translations.literal: Within a few days Huaiguang indeed seized Jianhui and Huiyuan and absorbed their troops. Jianhui escaped; Huiyuan was killed by Huaiguang.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few days Huaiguang indeed seized Jianhui and Huiyuan and absorbed their troops. Jianhui escaped; Huiyuan was killed by Huaiguang.

sentences.zh: 是日，車駕幸梁州。

translations.literal: That day the imperial carriage went to Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That day the imperial carriage went to Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時變生倉卒，百官扈從者十二三，駱谷道路險阻，儲供無素，從官乏食，上嘆曰：「早從李晟之言，三蜀可坐致也。」

translations.literal: The crisis arose in sudden haste. Only one or two out of ten officials accompanied the emperor. The Luogu road was perilous, supplies had not been prepared, and the attending officials lacked food. The emperor sighed: "Had I followed Li Sheng's counsel earlier, the Three Shu could have been secured without effort."
translations.idiomatic: The crisis arose in sudden haste. Only one or two out of ten officials accompanied the emperor. The Luogu road was perilous, supplies had not been prepared, and the attending officials lacked food. The emperor sighed, "Had I followed Li Sheng's counsel earlier, the Three Shu could have been secured without effort."

sentences.zh: 晟大將張少弘自行在傳口詔授晟尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事，以安眾心。

translations.literal: Sheng's senior general Zhang Shaohong transmitted an oral edict from the emperor's presence appointing Sheng Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Co-Equal with the Secretariat, to steady the hearts of the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng's senior general Zhang Shaohong transmitted an oral edict from the emperor's presence appointing Sheng Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Co-Equal with the Secretariat, to steady the hearts of the troops.

sentences.zh: 晟拜哭受命，且曰：「長安宗廟所在，為天下本，若皆執羈靮，誰復京師？」

translations.literal: Sheng bowed, wept, and accepted the commission, saying: "Chang'an is where the imperial ancestral temples stand and the foundation of the realm. If all hold the bridle and do nothing, who will recover the capital?"
translations.idiomatic: Sheng bowed, wept, and accepted the commission, saying, "Chang'an is where the imperial ancestral temples stand and the foundation of the realm. If all hold the bridle and do nothing, who will recover the capital?"

sentences.zh: 乃浚城隍，繕兵甲，以圖收復。

translations.literal: He then deepened the moats and walls, repaired arms and armor, and planned recovery.
translations.idiomatic: He then deepened the moats and walls, repaired arms and armor, and planned recovery.

sentences.zh: 晟以孤軍獨當強寇，恐為二賊之所併，乃卑詞厚幣，偽致誠於懷光，外示推崇，內為之備。

translations.literal: Sheng, with a lone army facing a powerful enemy, feared being absorbed by the two rebels. He used humble words and rich gifts, feigning sincerity toward Huaiguang, outwardly showing esteem while inwardly preparing against him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng, with a lone army facing a powerful enemy, feared being absorbed by the two rebels. He used humble words and rich gifts, feigning sincerity toward Huaiguang, outwardly showing esteem while inwardly preparing against him.

sentences.zh: 時芻粟未集，乃令檢校戶部郎中張彧假京兆少尹，擇官吏以賦渭北畿縣。

translations.literal: At the time fodder and grain had not been gathered. He ordered Acting Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Zhang Yu to serve as Acting Junior Vice Prefect of Jingzhao and selected officials to levy the counties of the northern Wei metropolitan region.
translations.idiomatic: At the time fodder and grain had not been gathered. He ordered Acting Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Zhang Yu to serve as Acting Junior Vice Prefect of Jingzhao and selected officials to levy the counties of the northern Wei metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 不旬日，芻糧皆足，晟乃大陳三軍，令之曰：「國家多難，亂逆繼興，屬車駕西幸，關中無主。

translations.literal: Within less than ten days fodder and grain were all sufficient. Sheng then mustered the Three Armies in grand formation and addressed them: "The state faces many calamities; rebellions rise one after another. The imperial carriage has lately gone west. Guanzhong has no master.
translations.idiomatic: In less than ten days fodder and grain were fully supplied. Sheng then drew up the Three Armies in grand array and addressed them: "The state faces one calamity after another; rebellion follows rebellion. The imperial carriage has gone west, and Guanzhong has no lord.

sentences.zh: 予代受國恩，見危死節，臣子之分，況當此時，不能誅滅兇渠，以取富貴，非人豪也。

translations.literal: I inherit the state's grace on another's behalf. To face peril and die for honor is a subject's duty. Especially at such a time, if one cannot destroy the wicked chief to win wealth and rank, one is no true hero.
translations.idiomatic: I stand in another's place to receive the state's grace. To meet danger and die for principle is a subject's portion. At such an hour, if one cannot cut down the wicked ringleader and instead seeks wealth and rank, one is no true champion.

sentences.zh: 渭橋橫跨大川，斷賊首尾，吾與公等戮力勤王，擇利而進，興復大業，建不世之功，能從我乎？」

translations.literal: Wei Bridge spans the great river and can sever the rebels head from tail. Let us join strength to serve the throne, advance where advantage lies, restore the great enterprise, and build everlasting merit. Will you follow me?"
translations.idiomatic: Wei Bridge crosses the great river and can cut the rebels in two. Let us join our strength to restore the throne, advance where gain lies, revive the great enterprise, and win undying merit. Will you follow me?"

sentences.zh: 三軍無不泣下，曰：「唯公所使。」

translations.literal: The Three Armies all wept and said: "We follow wherever the general commands."
translations.idiomatic: The whole army wept and said, "We go wherever you send us."

sentences.zh: 晟亦歔欷流涕。

translations.literal: Sheng too sighed and wept.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng too sighed and wept.

sentences.zh: 是時，硃泚盜據京城，懷光圖為反噬，河朔僭偽者三，李納虎視於河南，希烈鴟張於汴、鄭。

translations.literal: At that time Zhu Ci illegally held the capital. Huaiguang plotted to turn and devour his allies. Three usurpers held power in Hedei. Li Na watched Henan like a tiger. Xilie strutted arrogantly at Bian and Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhu Ci held the capital by force. Huaiguang plotted to turn and strike back at his allies. Three false rulers held sway in Hedei. Li Na watched Henan like a tiger. Xilie swaggered over Bian and Zheng.

sentences.zh: 晟內無貨財，外無轉輸，以孤軍而抗劇賊，而銳氣不衰，徒以忠義感於人心，故英豪歸向。

translations.literal: Sheng had no wealth within and no supplies from without. With a lone army he resisted fierce rebels, yet his sharp spirit did not fade—only because loyalty and righteousness moved men's hearts, so heroes turned toward him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng had no stores within and no transport from without. With a lone army he faced fierce rebels, yet his fighting spirit never slackened—because loyalty and righteousness moved men's hearts, and heroes rallied to him.

sentences.zh: 戴休顏率奉天之眾，韓遊瑰治邠寧之師，駱元光以華州之兵守潼關，尚可孤以神策之旅屯七盤，皆稟晟節度，晟軍大振。

translations.literal: Dai Xiuyan led the forces of Fengtian. Han Yougui commanded the Binning army. Luo Yuanguang held Tong Pass with Hua Prefecture troops. Shang Kehu garrisoned Qipan with Divine Strategy troops. All obeyed Sheng's command, and Sheng's army greatly revived.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Xiuyan led the Fengtian forces. Han Yougui commanded the Binning army. Luo Yuanguang held Tong Pass with troops from Hua Prefecture. Shang Kehu garrisoned Qipan with a Divine Strategy detachment. All took orders from Sheng, and his army greatly revived.

sentences.zh: 懷光以休顏、遊瑰從晟，益懼。

translations.literal: Huaiguang, because Xiuyan and Yougui followed Sheng, grew still more afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xiuyan and Yougui had joined Sheng, Huaiguang grew still more afraid.

sentences.zh: 晟又致書於懷光，諭以禍福，令破賊迎鑾，以掩前過。

translations.literal: Sheng also sent a letter to Huaiguang, explaining fortune and disaster, ordering him to break the rebels and welcome the imperial carriage back, to cover over past faults.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng also wrote to Huaiguang, explaining the consequences of fortune and ruin, and ordered him to break the rebels and welcome the imperial carriage home, so as to atone for past faults.

sentences.zh: 懷光卒不悟，軍眾漸多離散，糗糧且竭，虜剽無所得，懼為晟所襲。

translations.literal: Huaiguang in the end did not understand. His troops gradually scattered more and more. Provisions were nearly exhausted. Raids yielded nothing. He feared being struck by Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang never came to his senses. His troops steadily dwindled, provisions ran low, and raids brought in nothing. He feared Sheng would strike him.

sentences.zh: 三月，懷光自三原、富平東抵奉天，所至焚掠，乃自馮翊入據河中。

translations.literal: In the third month Huaiguang went east from Sanyuan and Fuping to Fengtian, burning and plundering wherever he passed, then entered Hezhong from Tongguan and seized it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Huaiguang marched east from Sanyuan and Fuping to Fengtian, burning and plundering as he went, then entered Hezhong from Fengyi and seized it.

sentences.zh: 懷光將孟涉、段威勇者，本神策將，惡懷光之不臣，既至富平，結陣於軍中，外向大呼而去，懷光不能制。

translations.literal: Huaiguang's generals Meng She and Duan Weiyong, formerly Divine Strategy officers, hated Huaiguang's disloyalty. When they reached Fuping they formed ranks in camp, shouted outward, and marched away. Huaiguang could not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiguang's generals Meng She and Duan Weiyong, formerly Divine Strategy officers, hated Huaiguang's treason. At Fuping they formed ranks in camp, shouted to the outside, and marched away. Huaiguang could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 涉、威勇以數千人歸晟，乃陳兵受涉等降卒，乃奏授涉檢校工部尚書，威勇兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: She and Weiyong returned to Sheng with several thousand men. Sheng then deployed troops to receive She and the surrendered soldiers, then memorialized appointing She Acting Minister of Works and Weiyong concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: She and Weiyong returned to Sheng with several thousand men. Sheng drew up his troops to receive them, then memorialized to appoint She Acting Minister of Works and Weiyong concurrent Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 德宗之幸山南，既入駱谷，謂渾瑊曰：「渭橋在賊腹內，兵勢懸隔，李晟可辦事乎？」

translations.literal: When Dezong went south to the mountains and had entered Luogu Pass, he said to Hun Jian: "Wei Bridge lies in the rebels' belly. Our military power is far separated. Can Li Sheng get the job done?"
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong fled south into the mountains and had entered Luogu Pass, he said to Hun Jian, "Wei Bridge lies deep in rebel territory, and our armies are far apart. Can Li Sheng manage this?"

sentences.zh: 瑊對曰：「李晟秉義執誌，臨事不可奪，以臣計之，破賊必矣。」

translations.literal: Jian replied: "Li Sheng holds to righteousness and firm purpose. In crisis his resolve cannot be shaken. By my reckoning, he will surely break the rebels."
translations.idiomatic: Jian replied, "Li Sheng holds to righteousness and keeps his purpose firm. In crisis no one can shake him. By my reckoning, he will surely break the rebels."

sentences.zh: 帝意始安。

translations.literal: The emperor's mind was finally eased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's mind was finally eased.

sentences.zh: 是月，渾瑊步將上官望自間道懷詔書加晟檢校右僕射，兼河中尹、河中晉絳慈隰節度使，益實封三百戶，又兼京畿、渭北、鄜坊丹延節度招討使。

translations.literal: That month Hun Jian's infantry officer Shangguan Wang, by a hidden route with imperial edict, promoted Sheng to Acting Right Vice Director and concurrent Prefect of Hezhong, Hezhong-Jin-Jiang-Ci-Sui military governor, with an additional three hundred taxable households, and also Coordinator-in-Chief for the metropolitan regions of Jingji, Weibei, and Yanfang-Danyan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hun Jian's infantry officer Shangguan Wang, carrying an edict by a hidden route, promoted Sheng to Acting Right Vice Director, concurrent Prefect of Hezhong and Military Governor of Hezhong-Jin-Jiang-Ci-Sui, with an additional three hundred taxable households, and also made him Coordinator-in-Chief for the armies of Jingji, Weibei, and Yanfang-Danyan.

sentences.zh: 晟承詔流涕。

translations.literal: Sheng received the edict with tears streaming.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng received the edict in tears.

sentences.zh: 時帝欲移幸西川，晟上表：「請駐蹕梁漢，系億兆之心，圖翦滅之勢。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor wished to move to Xichuan. Sheng submitted a memorial: "I ask that Your Majesty halt at Liang and Han, to bind the hearts of the countless people and plan the power to cut down and destroy the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor wished to move the court to Xichuan. Sheng submitted a memorial: "I ask that Your Majesty halt at Liang and Han, to hold the hearts of the countless people and plan the means to cut down and destroy the rebels.

sentences.zh: 若規小舍大，作都岷峨，即人心失望，武士謀臣無所施矣。」

translations.literal: If you aim small and abandon the great, making your capital at Min and E, men's hearts will despair and warriors and strategists will have nowhere to apply their skill."
translations.idiomatic: If you choose the lesser and abandon the greater, making your capital among Min and E, the people's hearts will fail and warriors and strategists will have nowhere to apply their talents."

sentences.zh: 四月，有詔加晟京畿、渭北、鄜坊、商華兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: In the fourth month an edict added Sheng as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the troops of Jingji, Weibei, Yanfang, and Shanghua.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict made Sheng Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the armies of Jingji, Weibei, Yanfang, and Shanghua.

sentences.zh: 時京兆府司錄李敬仲自京城來，諫議大夫鄭雲逵自奉天至，晟以京兆少尹張彧為副使，鄭雲逵為行軍司馬，李敬仲為節度判官，俾同主軍畫。

translations.literal: At the time Li Jingzhong, Recorder of Jingzhao Prefecture, came from the capital. Remonstrance and Advice Grandee Zheng Yunkui came from Fengtian. Sheng made Vice Prefect of Jingzhao Zhang Yu his deputy, Zheng Yunkui his march commander, and Li Jingzhong his military governor's judge, so that together they directed the army's plans.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Li Jingzhong, Recorder of Jingzhao Prefecture, came from the capital, and Remonstrance and Advice Grandee Zheng Yunkui came from Fengtian. Sheng made Vice Prefect of Jingzhao Zhang Yu his deputy, Zheng Yunkui his march commander, and Li Jingzhong his military judge, so that together they directed the army's plans.

sentences.zh: 又請以懷光舊將唐良臣保潼關，以河中節度授之；

translations.literal: He also asked that Huaiguang's former general Tang Liangchen guard Tong Pass and be granted the Hezhong military governorship;
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Huaiguang's former general Tang Liangchen hold Tong Pass and be granted the Hezhong military governorship;

sentences.zh: 戴休顏守奉天，請以鄜坊節度授之；

translations.literal: that Dai Xiuyan hold Fengtian and be granted the Yanfang military governorship;
translations.idiomatic: that Dai Xiuyan hold Fengtian and be granted the Yanfang military governorship;

sentences.zh: 上皆從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 渭橋舊有粟十余萬斛，度支先饋懷光軍欲盡，晟又奏曰：「近畿雖乘兵亂，猶可賦斂，儻寇賊未滅，宿兵曠時，人廢耕桑，又無儲蓄，非防微制勝之術也。」

translations.literal: Wei Bridge formerly held more than a hundred thousand bushels of grain. The Finance Office had nearly exhausted it feeding Huaiguang's army. Sheng again memorialized: "Though the near metropolis has suffered military chaos, taxation can still be levied. If the rebels are not yet destroyed and troops camp for long, people will abandon farming and silk cultivation and there will be no reserves. This is not the way to prevent trouble early and achieve victory."
translations.idiomatic: Wei Bridge once held more than a hundred thousand bushels of grain, and the Finance Office had nearly exhausted it feeding Huaiguang's army. Sheng memorialized again: "Though the near capital has suffered military chaos, taxes can still be levied. If the rebels are not yet destroyed and troops linger long, people will abandon farming and weaving and there will be no reserves. That is not the way to check trouble early and win."

sentences.zh: 上納之。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted it.

sentences.zh: 晟乃於畿甸率聚征賦，吏民樂輸，守禦益固，由是軍不乏食。

translations.literal: Sheng then in the metropolitan region gathered taxes in large numbers. Officials and people gladly paid. Defense grew firmer, and from this the army lacked no food.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng then gathered taxes across the metropolitan region. Officials and people paid gladly, defenses grew stronger, and from that time the army lacked no food.

sentences.zh: 神策軍家族多陷於泚，晟家亦百口在賊中，左右或有言及家者，晟因泣下曰：「乘輿何在，而敢恤家乎！」

translations.literal: Many Divine Strategy Army families were trapped with Zhu Ci. Sheng's family too—more than a hundred mouths—were in enemy hands. When those around him sometimes spoke of family, Sheng wept and said: "Where is the imperial carriage, that I should dare care for my household!"
translations.idiomatic: Many Divine Strategy Army families were trapped with Zhu Ci. More than a hundred of Sheng's own kin were in enemy hands. When those around him spoke of family, Sheng wept and said, "Where is the imperial carriage, that I should dare think of home!"

sentences.zh: 泚又使晟小吏王無忌之婿詣晟軍，且曰：「公家無恙，城中有書聞。」

translations.literal: Zhu Ci also sent the son-in-law of Sheng's petty clerk Wang Wuji to Sheng's army, saying: "Your household is unharmed. There is word from the city."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci also sent the son-in-law of Sheng's petty clerk Wang Wuji to his camp, saying, "Your household is safe. There is word from the city."

sentences.zh: 晟曰：「爾敢與賊為間！」

translations.literal: Sheng said: "You dare act as the rebels' spy!"
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said, "You dare serve as the rebels' spy!"

sentences.zh: 遽命斬之。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered him beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately ordered him beheaded.

sentences.zh: 時轉輸不至，盛夏軍士或衣裘褐，晟亦同勞苦，每以大義奮激士心，卒無離叛者。

translations.literal: At the time transport did not arrive. In midsummer soldiers sometimes wore fur and coarse cloth. Sheng shared their hardship. He constantly roused the men's spirit with great righteousness, and in the end none deserted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time supplies did not arrive. In midsummer some soldiers still wore furs and coarse cloth. Sheng shared their hardship, constantly rousing them with appeals to duty, and in the end none deserted.

sentences.zh: 會將吏數輩自賊中逃來，言泚眾攜離可滅之狀，士心益奮。

translations.literal: Several officers who had escaped from the rebels came saying Zhu Ci's forces were divided and could be destroyed. The men's spirit grew still bolder.
translations.idiomatic: Several officers escaped from the rebels and reported that Zhu Ci's forces were divided and could be destroyed. The men's spirit grew still bolder.

sentences.zh: 先是，賊將姚令言及偽中丞崔宣咸使諜覘我軍，為邏騎所得，拘送於晟，晟解縛，食而遣之，誡之曰：「爾報崔宣，善為賊守，諸人勉力自固，勿不忠於賊也！」

translations.literal: Earlier, rebel generals Yao Lingyan and the false Vice Director Cui Yuxian had sent spies to reconnoiter our army. Border cavalry captured them and sent them to Sheng. Sheng loosed their bonds, fed them, and sent them back, warning: "You tell Cui Yuxian: guard well for the rebels. All of you strive to hold firm—do not fail in loyalty to the rebels!"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the rebel generals Yao Lingyan and the false Vice Director Cui Yuxian had sent spies to reconnoiter the army. Border cavalry captured them and brought them to Sheng. Sheng loosed their bonds, fed them, and sent them back with a warning: "Tell Cui Yuxian to guard well for the rebels. Tell all of them to hold firm and stay loyal to the rebels!"

sentences.zh: 五月三日，晟引軍抵通化門，耀武而還，賊不敢出。

translations.literal: On the third day of the fifth month Sheng led his army to Tonghua Gate, displayed martial strength, and returned. The rebels did not dare come out.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day of the fifth month Sheng led his army to Tonghua Gate, displayed his strength, and withdrew. The rebels did not dare come out.

sentences.zh: 晨集將佐，圖兵所向，諸將曰：「先拔外城，既有市裏，然後北清宮闕。」

translations.literal: In the morning he gathered generals and staff to plan where the army should advance. The generals said: "First take the outer city. Once we have the market districts, then north to cleanse the palace precincts."
translations.idiomatic: In the morning he gathered his generals and staff to plan the army's advance. The generals said, "First take the outer city. Once we hold the markets, then move north to clear the palace precincts."

sentences.zh: 晟曰：「若先收坊市，巷陌隘狹，間以居人，若賊設伏格鬥，百姓囂潰，非計也。

translations.literal: Sheng said: "If we first take the wards and markets, the lanes and alleys are narrow and cramped, cut through by residents. If the rebels set ambushes and fight, the people will panic and scatter. That is no plan.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said, "If we first take the wards and markets, the lanes are narrow and crowded with residents. If the rebels set ambushes and fight there, the people will panic and scatter. That is no plan.

sentences.zh: 且賊重兵堅甲，皆在苑中，若自苑擊其心腹，彼將圖走不暇，如此則宮闕保安，市不易肆，計之上也。」

translations.literal: Moreover the rebels' heavy troops and strong armor are all in the imperial park. If we strike their vitals from the park, they will think only of flight and have no time for more. Thus the palace precincts will be secured and the markets undisturbed. This is the superior plan."
translations.idiomatic: Besides, the rebels' heavy troops and strong armor are all in the imperial park. If we strike their vitals from the park, they will think only of flight. Then the palace precincts will be secure and the markets undisturbed. That is the best plan."

sentences.zh: 諸將曰：「善」。

translations.literal: The generals said: "Good."
translations.idiomatic: The generals said, "Good."

sentences.zh: 乃移書瑊、駱元光、尚可孤，克期進軍於城下。

translations.literal: He then sent letters to Jian, Luo Yuanguang, and Shang Kehu, fixing a date to advance on the city together.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent letters to Jian, Luo Yuanguang, and Shang Kehu, fixing a date to advance on the city together.

sentences.zh: 其月二十五日夜，晟自東渭橋移軍於光泰門外米倉村，以薄京城。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth night of that month Sheng moved his army from East Wei Bridge to Milang Village outside Guangtai Gate to press close to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fifth night of that month Sheng moved his army from East Wei Bridge to Milang Village outside Guangtai Gate to press close to the capital.

sentences.zh: 晟臨高指麾，令設壕柵以候賊軍。

translations.literal: Sheng took high ground to command, ordering trenches and palisades set to await the rebel army.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng took high ground to command, ordering trenches and palisades set to await the rebel army.

sentences.zh: 俄而賊眾大至，賊驍將張庭芝、李希倩逼柵求戰，晟謂諸將曰：「吾恐賊不出，今冒死而來，天贊我也！」

translations.literal: Soon the rebel forces arrived in great numbers. Rebel fierce generals Zhang Tingzhi and Li Xiqian pressed the palisade seeking battle. Sheng told the generals: "I feared the rebels would not come out. Now they come courting death—Heaven favors us!"
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebel forces arrived in strength. Rebel fierce generals Zhang Tingzhi and Li Xiqian pressed the palisade seeking battle. Sheng told his generals, "I feared the rebels would not come out. Now they come courting death—Heaven favors us!"

sentences.zh: 勒吳詵、康英俊、史萬頃、孟涉等縱兵擊之。

translations.literal: He ordered Wu Shen, Kang Yingjun, Shi Wanqing, Meng She, and others to unleash their troops and strike them.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Wu Shen, Kang Yingjun, Shi Wanqing, Meng She, and others to unleash their troops and strike them.

sentences.zh: 時華州營在北，兵少，賊併力攻之，晟遣李演、孟華以精卒救之。

translations.literal: At the time the Hua Prefecture camp was to the north with few troops. The rebels combined strength to attack it. Sheng sent Li Yan and Meng Hua with elite troops to rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Hua Prefecture camp was to the north with few troops. The rebels combined strength to attack it. Sheng sent Li Yan and Meng Hua with elite troops to rescue them.

sentences.zh: 中軍鼓噪，演力戰，大破之，乘勝入光泰門；

translations.literal: The center army beat drums and shouted. Yan fought hard and routed them, pressing the victory into Guangtai Gate;
translations.idiomatic: The center army beat drums and shouted. Yan fought hard and routed them, pressing the victory into Guangtai Gate;

sentences.zh: 再戰，又敗之，僵屍蔽地，余眾走入白華，夜聞慟哭之聲。

translations.literal: Fighting again, he defeated them once more. Dead bodies covered the ground. The remainder fled into Baihua. At night came sounds of wailing grief.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting again, he defeated them once more. Dead bodies covered the ground. The remainder fled into Baihua. At night came sounds of wailing grief.

sentences.zh: 翌日，將復出師，諸將請待西軍至，則左右夾攻。

translations.literal: The next day, as he was about to march out again, the generals asked to wait until the western army arrived, then attack from both sides.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, as he was about to march out again, the generals asked to wait until the western army arrived and then attack from both sides.

sentences.zh: 晟曰：「賊既傷敗，須乘勝撲滅，若俟其有備，豈王師之利耶！

translations.literal: Sheng said: "The rebels are already wounded and broken. We must press the victory and exterminate them. If we wait until they are prepared, how will that profit the imperial army!
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said, "The rebels are already broken. We must press the victory and destroy them. If we wait until they are ready, how will that serve the imperial army!

sentences.zh: 如待西軍，恐失機便。」

translations.literal: To wait for the western army is to fear missing the moment of opportunity."
translations.idiomatic: To wait for the western army is to miss our chance."

sentences.zh: 二十八日，晟大集諸將駱元光、尚可孤，兵馬使吳詵、王佖，都虞候邢君牙、李演、史萬頃，神策將孟涉、康英俊，華州將郭審金、權文成，商州將彭元俊等，號令誓師畢，陳兵於光泰門外。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth Sheng greatly gathered the generals Luo Yuanguang, Shang Kehu, Military Commissioner Wu Shen and Wang Bi, Chief Adjutants Xing Junya, Li Yan, and Shi Wanqing, Divine Strategy officers Meng She and Kang Yingjun, Hua Prefecture officers Guo Shenjin and Quan Wencheng, Shang Prefecture officer Peng Yuanjun, and others. Once orders and oaths were complete, he deployed troops outside Guangtai Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth Sheng gathered his generals Luo Yuanguang, Shang Kehu, military commissioners Wu Shen and Wang Bi, chief adjutants Xing Junya, Li Yan, and Shi Wanqing, Divine Strategy officers Meng She and Kang Yingjun, Hua Prefecture officers Guo Shenjin and Quan Wencheng, Shang Prefecture officer Peng Yuanjun, and others. Once orders and oaths were complete, he deployed troops outside Guangtai Gate.

sentences.zh: 乃使王佖、李演率騎軍，史萬頃領步卒，直抵苑墻神麚村。

translations.literal: He then sent Wang Bi and Li Yan to lead the cavalry and Shi Wanqing to command the infantry, going straight to Shenli Village at the park wall.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Wang Bi and Li Yan to lead the cavalry and Shi Wanqing to command the infantry, going straight to Shenli Village at the park wall.

sentences.zh: 晟先是夜使人開苑墻二百余步，至是賊已樹木柵之，賊倚柵拒戰。

translations.literal: Sheng had earlier that night had men open more than two hundred paces of the park wall. By then the rebels had barricaded it with timber. They leaned on the barricade to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng had earlier that night had men open more than two hundred paces of the park wall. By then the rebels had barricaded it with timber and fought from behind the barrier.

sentences.zh: 晟叱軍士曰：「安得縱賊如此，當先斬公等！」

translations.literal: Sheng berated the soldiers: "How can you let the rebels do this? I ought to behead you first!"
translations.idiomatic: Sheng berated the soldiers: "How can you let the rebels do this? I ought to behead you first!"

sentences.zh: 萬頃懼，先登，拔柵而入，王佖騎軍繼進，賊即奔潰，獲賊將段誠諫，大軍分道並入，鼓噪雷動。

translations.literal: Wanqing feared this, climbed first, tore down the barricade and entered. Wang Bi's cavalry followed. The rebels at once broke and fled. They captured rebel general Duan Chengjian. The great army entered by separate routes together, drums and shouts thundering.
translations.idiomatic: Wanqing, afraid, climbed first, tore down the barricade, and entered. Wang Bi's cavalry followed. The rebels at once broke and fled. They captured rebel general Duan Chengjian. The main army entered by separate routes together, drums and shouts thundering.

sentences.zh: 姚令言、張庭芝、李希倩猶力捍官軍，晟令決勝軍使唐良臣、兵馬使趙光銑、楊萬榮、孟日華等步騎齊進，賊軍陣成而屢北。

translations.literal: Yao Lingyan, Zhang Tingzhi, and Li Xiqian still fought hard against the imperial army. Sheng ordered Victory Army commander Tang Liangchen and military commissioners Zhao Guangxuan, Yang Wanrong, Meng Rihua, and others to advance together, infantry and cavalry. The rebel army formed ranks but repeatedly fell back.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Lingyan, Zhang Tingzhi, and Li Xiqian still fought hard against the imperial army. Sheng ordered Victory Army commander Tang Liangchen and military commissioners Zhao Guangxuan, Yang Wanrong, Meng Rihua, and others to advance together, infantry and cavalry. The rebel army formed ranks but repeatedly fell back.

sentences.zh: 戰十余合，乘勝驅蹙，至於白華。

translations.literal: After more than ten engagements, pressing the victory they drove and crowded the rebels as far as Baihua.
translations.idiomatic: After more than ten engagements, pressing the victory they drove the rebels as far as Baihua.

sentences.zh: 忽有賊騎千余出於官軍之背，晟以麾下百余騎馳之，左右呼曰：「相公來！」

translations.literal: Suddenly more than a thousand rebel horsemen appeared behind the imperial army. Sheng with a little over a hundred horsemen of his own retinue galloped at them. Those at his sides shouted: "The Chancellor comes!"
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly more than a thousand rebel horsemen appeared behind the imperial army. Sheng with a little over a hundred horsemen of his own retinue galloped at them. Those at his sides shouted, "The Chancellor comes!"

sentences.zh: 賊聞之驚潰，官軍追斬，不可勝計。

translations.literal: The rebels heard this and broke in panic. The imperial army pursued and cut them down beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels heard this and broke in panic. The imperial army pursued and cut them down beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 硃泚、姚令言、張庭芝尚有眾萬人，相率遁走，晟遣田子奇追之，其余兇黨相率來降。

translations.literal: Zhu Ci, Yao Lingyan, and Zhang Tingzhi still had a force of ten thousand. They fled together. Sheng sent Tian Ziqi in pursuit. The rest of the wicked faction came over in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci, Yao Lingyan, and Zhang Tingzhi still had a force of ten thousand. They fled together. Sheng sent Tian Ziqi in pursuit. The rest of the wicked faction surrendered in succession.

sentences.zh: 是日，晟軍入京城，勒兵屯於含元殿前，晟舍於右金吾仗，仍號令諸軍曰「晟實不武，上憑睿算，下賴士心，幸得殲厥兇渠，肅清宮禁，皆三軍之力也。

translations.literal: That day Sheng's army entered the capital, ordered troops to camp before Hanyuan Hall. Sheng lodged at the Right Jinwu Guard station. He still ordered the armies: "Sheng is truly not martial. Above we relied on the emperor's wise calculations, below on the soldiers' hearts. By good fortune we were able to destroy the wicked chiefs and cleanse the palace precincts—all through the Three Armies' strength.
translations.idiomatic: That day Sheng's army entered the capital and ordered troops to camp before Hanyuan Hall. Sheng lodged at the Right Jinwu Guard station. He still ordered the armies, "Sheng is truly not martial. Above we relied on the emperor's wise calculations; below on the soldiers' hearts. By good fortune we destroyed the wicked chiefs and cleansed the palace precincts—all through the Three Armies' strength.

sentences.zh: 長安士庶，久陷賊庭，若小有震驚，則非伐罪吊人之義也。

translations.literal: The gentlemen and common people of Chang'an have long been trapped in the rebels' court. If there is the slightest alarm, that is not the meaning of punishing crime and comforting the people.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Chang'an have long been trapped in the rebels' court. If there is the slightest alarm, that is not the meaning of punishing crime and comforting the people.

sentences.zh: 晟與公等各有家室，離別數年，今已成功，相見非晚，五日內不得輒通家信，違命者斬。」

translations.literal: Sheng and you all have households, parted for years. Now success is achieved—meeting again is not far off. Within five days you must not send word home on your own. Whoever disobeys will be beheaded."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng and you all have households, parted for years. Now success is achieved—meeting again is not far off. Within five days you must not send word home on your own. Whoever disobeys will be beheaded."

sentences.zh: 乃遣京兆尹李齊運、攝長安令陳元眾、攝萬年令韋上伋告喻百姓，居人安堵，秋毫無所犯。

translations.literal: He then sent Jingzhao Prefect Li Qiyun, Acting Chang'an Magistrate Chen Yuanzhong, and Acting Wannian Magistrate Wei Shangji to announce and instruct the people. Residents settled in peace. Not the slightest thing was violated.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Jingzhao Prefect Li Qiyun, Acting Chang'an Magistrate Chen Yuanzhong, and Acting Wannian Magistrate Wei Shangji to announce and instruct the people. Residents settled in peace. Not the slightest thing was violated.

sentences.zh: 尚可孤軍人有擅取賊馬者，晟大將高明曜虜賊女妓一人，司馬伷取賊馬二匹，晟皆立斬之，莫敢忤視。

translations.literal: A soldier of Shang Kehu's army had taken a rebel horse without permission. Sheng's senior general Gao Mingyao seized one rebel courtesan. The deputy march commander Zhou took two rebel horses. Sheng had all immediately beheaded. None dared meet his gaze.
translations.idiomatic: A soldier of Shang Kehu's army had taken a rebel horse without permission. Sheng's senior general Gao Mingyao seized one rebel courtesan. The deputy march commander Zhou took two rebel horses. Sheng had all three immediately beheaded. None dared meet his gaze.

sentences.zh: 士庶無不感悅，鹹歔欷流涕，遠坊居人，亦有經宿方知者。

translations.literal: Gentlemen and common people were all moved with joy. All sighed and wept. Residents in distant wards sometimes did not know until a full day and night had passed.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen and common people were all moved with joy. All sighed and wept. Residents in distant wards sometimes did not know until a full day and night had passed.

sentences.zh: 二十九日，令孟涉屯於白華，尚可孤屯望仙門，駱元光屯章敬寺，晟自屯於安國寺。

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth he ordered Meng She to camp at Baihua, Shang Kehu at Wangxian Gate, Luo Yuanguang at Zhangjing Temple, and Sheng himself at Anguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth he ordered Meng She to camp at Baihua, Shang Kehu at Wangxian Gate, Luo Yuanguang at Zhangjing Temple, and Sheng himself at Anguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 是日，斬賊將李希倩等八人，徇於市。

translations.literal: That day he beheaded eight men including rebel general Li Xiqian and displayed them in the market.
translations.idiomatic: That day he beheaded eight men including rebel general Li Xiqian and displayed them in the market.

sentences.zh: 六月四日，晟破賊露布至梁州，上覽之感泣，群臣無不隕涕，因上壽稱萬歲，奏曰：「李晟虔奉聖謨，蕩滌兇醜。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the sixth month Sheng's victory bulletin on breaking the rebels reached Liang Prefecture. The emperor read it with moved tears. The assembled ministers all shed tears. They then offered birthday wishes and cried "Ten thousand years!" memorializing: "Li Sheng devoutly carried out the sage's design and swept away the wicked ugliness.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the sixth month Sheng's victory bulletin on breaking the rebels reached Liang Prefecture. The emperor read it with moved tears. The assembled ministers all shed tears. They then offered birthday wishes and cried "Ten thousand years!" memorializing, "Li Sheng devoutly carried out the sage's design and swept away the wicked ugliness.

sentences.zh: 然古之樹勛，力復都邑者，往往有之；

translations.literal: Yet in antiquity those who planted merit and by force recovered capitals—there have often been such.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in antiquity those who planted merit and by force recovered capitals—there have often been such.

sentences.zh: 至於不驚宗廟，不易市肆，長安人不識旗鼓，安堵如初，自三代以來，未之有也。」

translations.literal: But as for not alarming the ancestral temples, not disturbing the markets, Chang'an people not knowing drums and banners, settling at peace as before—from the Three Dynasties onward there has never been such."
translations.idiomatic: But as for not alarming the ancestral temples, not disturbing the markets, Chang'an people not knowing drums and banners, settling at peace as before—from the Three Dynasties onward there has never been such."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「天生李晟，為社稷萬人，不為朕也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Heaven born Li Sheng—for the altar of state and for the ten thousand people, not for me alone."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Heaven born Li Sheng—for the altar of state and for the ten thousand people, not for me alone."

sentences.zh: 百官拜賀而退。

translations.literal: The hundred officials bowed in congratulation and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials bowed in congratulation and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是日，晟斬偽相李忠臣、張光晟、蔣鎮、喬琳、洪經綸、崔宣等，又表守臣節不屈於賊者程鎮之、劉乃、蔣沇、趙曄、薛岌等。

translations.literal: That day Sheng beheaded the false chancellors Li Zhongchen, Zhang Guangsheng, Jiang Zhen, Qiao Lin, Hong Jinglun, Cui Xuan, and others. He also memorialized those who held ministerial integrity and did not yield to the rebels: Cheng Zhenzhi, Liu Nai, Jiang Yan, Zhao Ye, Xue Ji, and others.
translations.idiomatic: That day Sheng beheaded the false chancellors Li Zhongchen, Zhang Guangsheng, Jiang Zhen, Qiao Lin, Hong Jinglun, Cui Xuan, and others. He also memorialized those who held ministerial integrity and did not yield to the rebels: Cheng Zhenzhi, Liu Nai, Jiang Yan, Zhao Ye, Xue Ji, and others.

sentences.zh: 晟初屯渭橋時，熒惑守歲，久之方退，賓介或勸曰：「今熒惑已退，皇家之利也，可速用兵。」

translations.literal: When Sheng first encamped at Wei Bridge, Mars guarded the Year Star. Only after a long while did it withdraw. Guests and aides sometimes urged: "Now Mars has withdrawn—this is the dynasty's gain. You should use troops quickly."
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng first encamped at Wei Bridge, Mars guarded the Year Star. Only after a long while did it withdraw. Guests and aides sometimes urged, "Now Mars has withdrawn—this is the dynasty's gain. You should use troops quickly."

sentences.zh: 晟曰：「天子外次，人臣但當死節，垂象玄遠，吾安知天道耶！」

translations.literal: Sheng said: "The Son of Heaven is abroad on campaign. As subjects we should only die for honor. Celestial signs are profound and far. How would I know Heaven's way!"
translations.idiomatic: Sheng said, "The Son of Heaven is abroad on campaign. As subjects we should only die for honor. Celestial signs are profound and far. How would I know Heaven's way!"

sentences.zh: 至是，謂參佐曰：「前者士大夫勸晟出兵，非敢拒也，且軍可用之，不可使知之。

translations.literal: At this point he told his staff: "Before, when the gentlemen urged Sheng to march out, it was not that I dared refuse. Rather, the army can be used—but they must not be made to know.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he told his staff, "Before, when the gentlemen urged Sheng to march out, it was not that I dared refuse. Rather, the army can be used—but they must not be made to know.

sentences.zh: 嘗聞五緯盈縮無準，晟懼復來守歲，則我軍不戰而自潰。」

translations.literal: I have heard the Five Planets expand and contract without fixed rule. Sheng feared Mars would return to guard the Year Star. Then our army would break without fighting."
translations.idiomatic: I have heard the Five Planets expand and contract without fixed rule. Sheng feared Mars would return to guard the Year Star. Then our army would break without fighting."

sentences.zh: 參佐嘆服，皆曰：「非所及也。」

translations.literal: The staff sighed in admiration and all said: "This is beyond us."
translations.idiomatic: The staff sighed in admiration and all said, "This is beyond us."

sentences.zh: 尋拜晟司徒，兼中書令，實封一千戶。

translations.literal: Soon Sheng was appointed Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Director, with a thousand taxable households.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Sheng was appointed Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Director, with a thousand taxable households.

sentences.zh: 晟綜理以備百司，令大將吳詵將兵三千至寶雞清道，晟又請至鳳翔迎扈，不許。

translations.literal: Sheng put affairs in order to supply all offices. He ordered senior general Wu Shen to lead three thousand troops to Baoji to clear the roads. Sheng also asked to go to Fengxiang to welcome and escort the emperor. This was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng put affairs in order to supply all offices. He ordered senior general Wu Shen to lead three thousand troops to Baoji to clear the roads. Sheng also asked to go to Fengxiang to welcome and escort the emperor. This was not granted.

sentences.zh: 七月十三日，德宗至自興元，渾瑊、韓遊瑰、戴休顏以其兵扈從，晟與駱元光、尚可孤以其兵奉迎。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the seventh month Dezong arrived from Xingyuan. Hun Jian, Han Yougui, and Dai Xiuyan escorted with their troops. Sheng with Luo Yuanguang and Shang Kehu welcomed with their troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of the seventh month Dezong arrived from Xingyuan. Hun Jian, Han Yougui, and Dai Xiuyan escorted with their troops. Sheng with Luo Yuanguang and Shang Kehu welcomed with their troops.

sentences.zh: 時元從禁軍及山南、隴州、鳳翔之眾，步騎凡十余萬，旌旗連亙數十里，傾城士庶，夾道歡呼。

translations.literal: At the time the original accompanying Palace Guards and the forces of Shannan, Long Prefecture, and Fengxiang—infantry and cavalry totaling more than a hundred thousand—banners and flags stretching unbroken for several tens of li. The whole city's gentlemen and common people lined the road shouting welcome.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the original accompanying Palace Guards and the forces of Shannan, Long Prefecture, and Fengxiang—infantry and cavalry totaling more than a hundred thousand—banners and flags stretching unbroken for several tens of li. The whole city's gentlemen and common people lined the road shouting welcome.

sentences.zh: 晟以戎服謁見於三橋，上駐馬勞之。

translations.literal: Sheng in military dress paid respects at San Bridge. The emperor halted his horse to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng in military dress paid respects at San Bridge. The emperor halted his horse to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 晟再拜稽首，初賀元惡殄滅，宗廟再清，宮闈鹹肅，抃舞感涕，跪而言曰：「臣忝備爪牙之任，不能早誅妖逆，至鑾輿再遷。

translations.literal: Sheng bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground. First he congratulated that the chief villain was destroyed, the ancestral temples cleansed again, the palace precincts all in order.
