Dancing for joy with moved tears, he knelt and said: "Your subject undeservedly holds the post of claw and fang. I could not early execute the demonic rebels, until the imperial carriage moved twice.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground. First he congratulated that the chief villain was destroyed, the ancestral temples cleansed again, the palace precincts all in order. Dancing for joy with moved tears, he knelt and said, "Your subject undeservedly holds the post of claw and fang. I could not early execute the demonic rebels, until the imperial carriage moved twice.

sentences.zh: 及師於城隅，累月方殄賊寇，皆臣庸懦不任職之責，敢請死罪。」

translations.literal: When troops were at the city corner, only after many months were the rebels destroyed—all the fault of your subject's mediocrity and incompetence. I dare beg the death penalty."
translations.idiomatic: When troops were at the city corner, only after many months were the rebels destroyed—all the fault of your subject's mediocrity and incompetence. I dare beg the death penalty."

sentences.zh: 伏於路左。

translations.literal: He prostrated himself on the left side of the road.
translations.idiomatic: He prostrated himself on the left side of the road.

sentences.zh: 上為之掩涕，命給事中齊映宣旨，令左右起晟於馬前。

translations.literal: The emperor wiped tears for him and ordered Censor Qi Ying to proclaim the imperial will, commanding attendants to raise Sheng before his horse.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wiped tears for him and ordered Censor Qi Ying to proclaim the imperial will, commanding attendants to raise Sheng before his horse.

sentences.zh: 是月，禦殿大赦，贈晟父欽太子太保，母王氏贈代國夫人，賜永崇裏第及涇陽上田、延平門之林園、女樂八人。

translations.literal: That month the emperor held court for a great amnesty. Sheng's father Qin was posthumously granted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent. His mother Lady Wang was posthumously granted Lady of Daiguo. He was granted a mansion in Yongchong Ward, upper fields in Jingyang, the grove garden at Yanping Gate, and eight female musicians.
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor held court for a great amnesty. Sheng's father Qin was posthumously granted Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent. His mother Lady Wang was posthumously granted Lady of Daiguo. He was granted a mansion in Yongchong Ward, upper fields in Jingyang, the grove garden at Yanping Gate, and eight female musicians.

sentences.zh: 入第之日，京兆府供帳酒饌，賜教坊樂具，鼓吹迎導，宰臣節將送之，京師以為榮觀。

translations.literal: On the day he entered his mansion Jingzhao Prefecture supplied tents, wine, and food. The Music Office instruments were granted. Musical accompaniment welcomed and led him. Chancellors and military governors saw him home. The capital considered it a glorious sight.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he entered his mansion Jingzhao Prefecture supplied tents, wine, and food. The Music Office instruments were granted. Musical accompaniment welcomed and led him. Chancellors and military governors saw him home. The capital considered it a glorious sight.

sentences.zh: 上思晟勛力，制紀功碑，俾皇太子書之，刊石立於東渭橋，與天地悠久，又令太子書碑詞以賜晟。

translations.literal: The emperor, mindful of Sheng's merit, had an achievement stele composed. He had the Crown Prince write it, carved in stone and erected at East Wei Bridge to endure with heaven and earth. He also had the Crown Prince write the stele text and grant it to Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, mindful of Sheng's merit, had an achievement stele composed. He had the Crown Prince write it, carved in stone and erected at East Wei Bridge to endure with heaven and earth. He also had the Crown Prince write the stele text and grant it to Sheng.

sentences.zh: 晟以涇州倚邊，屢害戎帥，數為亂階，乃上書請理不用命者，兼備耕以積粟，攘卻西蕃，上皆從之。

translations.literal: Sheng, because Jing Prefecture bordered the frontier and repeatedly devoured frontier commanders, often becoming a source of rebellion, submitted a letter asking to punish the disobedient, also prepare farming to store grain, and drive back the Western Tibetans. The emperor approved all.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng, because Jing Prefecture bordered the frontier and repeatedly devoured frontier commanders, often becoming a source of rebellion, submitted a letter asking to punish the disobedient, also prepare farming to store grain, and drive back the Western Tibetans. The emperor approved all.

sentences.zh: 詔以晟兼鳳翔尹、鳳翔隴右節度使，仍充隴右涇原節度，兼管內諸軍及四鎮、北庭行營兵馬副元帥，改封西平郡王。

translations.literal: An edict made Sheng concurrent Prefect of Fengxiang and Military Governor of Fengxiang-Longyou, still serving as Military Governor of Longyou-Jingyuan, and Deputy Commander-in-Chief of all armies within his jurisdiction and of the Four Garrisons and Beiting field headquarters troops. He was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Sheng concurrent Prefect of Fengxiang and Military Governor of Fengxiang-Longyou, still serving as Military Governor of Longyou-Jingyuan, and Deputy Commander-in-Chief of all armies within his jurisdiction and of the Four Garrisons and Beiting field headquarters troops. He was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping Commandery.

sentences.zh: 初，帝在奉天，鳳翔軍亂，殺其帥張鎰，立小將李楚琳。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the emperor was at Fengtian, the Fengxiang army mutinied, killed its commander Zhang Yi, and installed junior officer Li Chuolin.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the emperor was at Fengtian, the Fengxiang army mutinied, killed its commander Zhang Yi, and installed junior officer Li Chuolin.

sentences.zh: 至是楚琳在朝，晟請以楚琳俱往鳳翔，將誅之，上以初復京師，方安反側，不許。

translations.literal: At this point Chuolin was at court. Sheng asked to take Chuolin with him to Fengxiang intending to execute him. The emperor, having just recovered the capital and still settling those who might turn, did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Chuolin was at court. Sheng asked to take Chuolin with him to Fengxiang intending to execute him. The emperor, having just recovered the capital and still settling those who might turn, did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 八月，晟至鳳翔，理殺張鎰之罪，斬王斌等十余人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Sheng reached Fengxiang, judged the crime of killing Zhang Yi, and beheaded more than ten men including Wang Bin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Sheng reached Fengxiang, judged the crime of killing Zhang Yi, and beheaded more than ten men including Wang Bin.

sentences.zh: 初，硃泚亂時，涇州亦殺其帥馮河清，立別將田希鑒，方屬播遷，不遑討伐，以涇帥授之。

translations.literal: Earlier, during Zhu Ci's rebellion, Jing Prefecture also killed its commander Feng Heqing and installed deputy general Tian Xijian. At the time of the imperial flight there was no leisure to punish them, and the Jing commandership was granted to him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during Zhu Ci's rebellion, Jing Prefecture also killed its commander Feng Heqing and installed deputy general Tian Xijian. At the time of the imperial flight there was no leisure to punish them, and the Jing commandership was granted to him.

sentences.zh: 至是，晟奏曰：「近者中原兵禍，皆起涇州，且其地逼西戎，易為反覆。

translations.literal: At this point Sheng memorialized: "Recently military disasters in the Central Plains have all begun at Jing Prefecture. Moreover its land presses on the Western Rong and easily turns fickle.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Sheng memorialized, "Recently military disasters in the Central Plains have all begun at Jing Prefecture. Moreover its land presses on the Western Rong and easily turns fickle.

sentences.zh: 希鑒兇徒，將校驕逆，若不懲革，終為後患。」

translations.literal: Xijian is a wicked ruffian. His officers are arrogant and rebellious. If not punished and reformed, he will become a future calamity."
translations.idiomatic: Xijian is a wicked ruffian. His officers are arrogant and rebellious. If not punished and reformed, he will become a future calamity."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 晟至鳳翔，托以巡邊，至涇州，希鑒迎謁，於坐執而誅之，並誅害河清者石奇等三十余人，具事以聞。

translations.literal: Sheng reached Fengxiang, then under pretext of patrolling the frontier went to Jing Prefecture. Xijian came to greet and pay respects. At the seat Sheng seized and executed him, and also executed more than thirty men including Shi Qi who had harmed Heqing. He reported the whole matter.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng reached Fengxiang, then under pretext of patrolling the frontier went to Jing Prefecture. Xijian came to greet and pay respects. At the seat Sheng seized and executed him, and also executed more than thirty men including Shi Qi who had harmed Heqing. He reported the whole matter.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「涇州亂逆泉藪，非晟莫能理之。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Jing Prefecture is a spring of rebellion and treason. None but Sheng can govern it."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Jing Prefecture is a spring of rebellion and treason. None but Sheng can govern it."

sentences.zh: 還鎮，表右龍武將軍李觀為涇原節度使，吐蕃深畏之。

translations.literal: Returning to his post, he memorialized Right Dragon Martial General Li Guan as Military Governor of Jingyuan. The Tibetans deeply feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to his post, he memorialized Right Dragon Martial General Li Guan as Military Governor of Jingyuan. The Tibetans deeply feared him.

sentences.zh: 晟常曰；

translations.literal: Sheng often said:
translations.idiomatic: Sheng often said:

sentences.zh: 「河、隴之陷也，豈吐蕃力取之，皆因將帥貪暴，種落攜貳，人不得耕稼，展轉東徙，自棄之耳。

translations.literal: "The fall of He and Long—was it taken by Tibetan strength? All of it came because commanders were greedy and brutal, tribes turned divided, people could not farm, and shifting east in succession they abandoned it themselves.
translations.idiomatic: "The fall of He and Long—was it taken by Tibetan strength? All of it came because commanders were greedy and brutal, tribes turned divided, people could not farm, and shifting east in succession they abandoned it themselves.

sentences.zh: 且土無絲絮，人苦征役，思唐之心，豈有已乎！」

translations.literal: Moreover the land has no silk and cotton. People suffer forced labor. The heart that yearns for Tang—how could it ever end!"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the land has no silk and cotton. People suffer forced labor. The heart that yearns for Tang—how could it ever end!"

sentences.zh: 乃傾家財以賞降者，以懷來之。

translations.literal: He then poured out family wealth to reward those who surrendered, to draw them by kindness.
translations.idiomatic: He then poured out family wealth to reward those who surrendered, to draw them by kindness.

sentences.zh: 降虜浪息曩，晟奏封王，每蕃使至，晟必置息曩於坐，衣以錦袍、金帶以寵異之。

translations.literal: A surrendered barbarian named Langxinang—Sheng memorialized to enfeoff him as king. Whenever Tibetan envoys came, Sheng always placed Xinang at the seat of honor, clothed him in brocade robes and a gold belt to favor and distinguish him.
translations.idiomatic: A surrendered barbarian named Langxinang—Sheng memorialized to enfeoff him as king. Whenever Tibetan envoys came, Sheng always placed Xinang at the seat of honor, clothed him in brocade robes and a gold belt to favor and distinguish him.

sentences.zh: 蕃人皆相指目，榮羨息曩。

translations.literal: Tibetans all pointed and looked, envying Xinang.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans all pointed and looked, envying Xinang.

sentences.zh: 蕃相尚結贊頗多詐謀，尤惡晟，乃相與議云：「唐之名將，李晟與馬燧、渾瑊耳。

translations.literal: Tibetan chancellor Shang Jiezan was full of treacherous schemes and especially hated Sheng. They discussed together: "Tang's famous generals are only Li Sheng, Ma Sui, and Hun Jian.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan chancellor Shang Jiezan was full of treacherous schemes and especially hated Sheng. They discussed together, "Tang's famous generals are only Li Sheng, Ma Sui, and Hun Jian.

sentences.zh: 不去三人，必為我憂。」

translations.literal: If these three are not removed, they will surely become our worry."
translations.idiomatic: If these three are not removed, they will surely become our worry."

sentences.zh: 乃行反間，遣使因馬燧以請和，既和，即請盟，復因盟以虜瑊，因以賣燧。

translations.literal: They then carried out a counter-espionage plot. They sent envoys through Ma Sui to ask for peace. Once at peace they asked for alliance. Then through alliance they captured Jian and thereby betrayed Sui.
translations.idiomatic: They then carried out a counter-espionage plot. They sent envoys through Ma Sui to ask for peace. Once at peace they asked for alliance. Then through alliance they captured Jian and thereby betrayed Sui.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年九月，吐蕃用尚結贊之計，乃大興兵入隴州，抵鳳翔，無所虜掠，且曰：「召我來，何不以牛酒犒勞？」

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan the Tibetans used Shang Jiezan's plan and raised great forces, entering Long Prefecture and reaching Fengxiang. They plundered nothing and said: "You summoned us—why not reward us with cattle and wine?"
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan the Tibetans used Shang Jiezan's plan and raised great forces, entering Long Prefecture and reaching Fengxiang. They plundered nothing and said, "You summoned us—why not reward us with cattle and wine?"

sentences.zh: 徐乃引去，持是間晟也。

translations.literal: Slowly they then withdrew, using this to drive a wedge against Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Slowly they then withdrew, using this to drive a wedge against Sheng.

sentences.zh: 是役也，晟先令衙將王佖選銳兵三千，設伏於汧陽，誡之曰：「蕃軍過城下，勿擊首尾，首尾縱敗，中軍力全，若合勢攻汝，必受其弊。

translations.literal: In this campaign Sheng first ordered staff officer Wang Bi to select three thousand crack troops and set an ambush at Qianyang, warning him: "When Tibetan troops pass below the city, do not strike head or tail. Even if head and tail are beaten, the center army's strength remains intact. If they combine force to attack you, you will surely suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: In this campaign Sheng first ordered staff officer Wang Bi to select three thousand crack troops and set an ambush at Qianyang, warning him, "When Tibetan troops pass below the city, do not strike head or tail. Even if head and tail are beaten, the center army's strength remains intact. If they combine force to attack you, you will surely suffer harm.

sentences.zh: 但俟其前軍已過，見五方旗、武豹衣，則其中軍也，突其不意，可建奇功。」

translations.literal: Only wait until their vanguard has passed. When you see the Five-Direction banner and martial leopard robes, that is their center army. Strike them unawares and you can achieve marvelous merit."
translations.idiomatic: Only wait until their vanguard has passed. When you see the Five-Direction banner and martial leopard robes, that is their center army. Strike them unawares and you can achieve marvelous merit."

sentences.zh: 佖如晟節度，果遇結贊。

translations.literal: Bi followed Sheng's instructions and indeed encountered Jiezan.
translations.idiomatic: Bi followed Sheng's instructions and indeed encountered Jiezan.

sentences.zh: 及出奮擊，賊皆披靡，佖軍不識結贊，故結贊僅而獲免。

translations.literal: When they sallied forth and struck hard, the enemy all collapsed. Bi's army did not recognize Jiezan, so Jiezan barely escaped.
translations.idiomatic: When they sallied forth and struck hard, the enemy all collapsed. Bi's army did not recognize Jiezan, so Jiezan barely escaped.

sentences.zh: 十月，晟出師襲吐蕃摧沙堡，拔之，斬其堡使扈屈律悉蒙等，自是結贊數遣使乞和。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Sheng marched out to raid the Tibetan Cuisha Fort, took it, and beheaded its fort commander Huchu Lv Simeng and others. From this Jiezan repeatedly sent envoys begging peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Sheng marched out to raid the Tibetan Cuisha Fort, took it, and beheaded its fort commander Huchu Lv Simeng and others. From this Jiezan repeatedly sent envoys begging peace.

sentences.zh: 十二月，晟朝京師，奏曰：「戎狄無信，不可許。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Sheng came to court at the capital and memorialized: "The Rong and Di are faithless. They cannot be granted this."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Sheng came to court at the capital and memorialized, "The Rong and Di are faithless. They cannot be granted this."

sentences.zh: 宰相韓滉又扶晟議，請調軍食以給晟，命將擊之。

translations.literal: Chancellor Han Huang also supported Sheng's view, asking to transfer military provisions to supply Sheng and command the generals to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Han Huang also supported Sheng's view, asking to transfer military provisions to supply Sheng and command the generals to strike them.

sentences.zh: 上方厭兵，疑將帥生事邀功。

translations.literal: The emperor was weary of war and suspected the generals of creating incidents to claim merit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was weary of war and suspected the generals of creating incidents to claim merit.

sentences.zh: 會滉卒，張延賞秉政，與晟有隙，屢於上前間晟，言不可久令典兵。

translations.literal: When Huang died, Zhang Yanshang took power. He had a rift with Sheng and repeatedly slandered Sheng before the emperor, saying he could not long be left in command of troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang died, Zhang Yanshang took power. He had a rift with Sheng and repeatedly slandered Sheng before the emperor, saying he could not long be left in command of troops.

sentences.zh: 延賞欲用劉玄佐、李抱真，委以西北邊事，俾立功以壓晟，德宗竟納延賞之言，罷晟兵柄。

translations.literal: Yanshang wished to use Liu Xuanzuo and Li Baozhen, entrusting them with northwestern frontier affairs, so they could win merit and overshadow Sheng. Dezong finally accepted Yanshang's words and removed Sheng's military authority.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshang wished to use Liu Xuanzuo and Li Baozhen, entrusting them with northwestern frontier affairs, so they could win merit and overshadow Sheng. Dezong finally accepted Yanshang's words and removed Sheng's military authority.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，冊拜晟為太尉、中書令，奉朝請而已。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year Sheng was appointed by edict Grand Commandant and Palace Director, attending court only.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year Sheng was appointed by edict Grand Commandant and Palace Director, attending court only.

sentences.zh: 其年閏五月，渾瑊與尚結贊同盟於平涼，果為蕃兵所劫，瑊單馬僅免，將吏皆陷。

translations.literal: That year in intercalary fifth month Hun Jian allied with Shang Jiezan at Pingliang. He was indeed seized by Tibetan troops. Jian alone on horseback barely escaped. Generals and officers were all trapped.
translations.idiomatic: That year in intercalary fifth month Hun Jian allied with Shang Jiezan at Pingliang. He was indeed seized by Tibetan troops. Jian alone on horseback barely escaped. Generals and officers were all trapped.

sentences.zh: 六月，罷河東節度使馬燧為司徒，盡中尚結贊之謀。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Military Governor Ma Sui of Hedong was removed and made Grand Preceptor—entirely fulfilling Shang Jiezan's scheme.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Military Governor Ma Sui of Hedong was removed and made Grand Preceptor—entirely fulfilling Shang Jiezan's scheme.

sentences.zh: 晟既罷兵權，朝謁之外，罕所過從。

translations.literal: Once Sheng had lost military authority, apart from court attendance he rarely went anywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Once Sheng had lost military authority, apart from court attendance he rarely went anywhere.

sentences.zh: 有通王府長史丁瓊者，亦為張延賞所排，心懷怨望，乃求見晟言事，且曰：「太尉功業至大，猶罷兵權，自古功高，無有保全者。

translations.literal: There was Chief Steward of the Prince of Tong Prefecture Ding Qiong, also pushed aside by Zhang Yanshang, who harbored resentment. He sought an audience with Sheng to speak on affairs, saying: "Grand Commandant, your achievements are very great, yet still your military authority was removed. Since antiquity, none with such high merit has preserved himself intact.
translations.idiomatic: There was Chief Steward of the Prince of Tong Prefecture Ding Qiong, also pushed aside by Zhang Yanshang, who harbored resentment. He sought an audience with Sheng to speak on affairs, saying, "Grand Commandant, your achievements are very great, yet still your military authority was removed. Since antiquity, none with such high merit has preserved himself intact.

sentences.zh: 國家倘有變故，瓊願備左右，狡兔三穴，盍早圖之。」

translations.literal: If the state should meet sudden change, Qiong wishes to serve at your side. A cunning rabbit has three burrows—why not plan early?"
translations.idiomatic: If the state should meet sudden change, Qiong wishes to serve at your side. A cunning rabbit has three burrows—why not plan early?"

sentences.zh: 晟怒曰：「爾安得不祥之言！」

translations.literal: Sheng angrily said: "How dare you speak such ill-omened words!"
translations.idiomatic: Sheng angrily said, "How dare you speak such ill-omened words!"

sentences.zh: 遽執瓊以聞。

translations.literal: He immediately seized Qiong and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately seized Qiong and reported it.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，詔為晟立五廟，以晟高祖芝贈隴州刺史，曾祖嵩贈澤州刺史，祖思恭贈幽州大都督。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year an edict ordered five ancestral temples established for Sheng. Sheng's great-great-grandfather Zhi was posthumously granted Prefect of Long Prefecture. His great-grandfather Song was posthumously granted Prefect of Ze Prefecture. His grandfather Sigong was posthumously granted Grand Protector of You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year an edict ordered five ancestral temples established for Sheng. Sheng's great-great-grandfather Zhi was posthumously granted Prefect of Long Prefecture. His great-grandfather Song was posthumously granted Prefect of Ze Prefecture. His grandfather Sigong was posthumously granted Grand Protector of You Prefectorate.

sentences.zh: 廟成，官給牲牢、祭器、床帳，禮官相儀以祔焉。

translations.literal: When the temples were completed, the government supplied sacrificial animals, ritual vessels, and bedding. Ritual officers assisted in the enshrinement rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the temples were completed, the government supplied sacrificial animals, ritual vessels, and bedding. Ritual officers assisted in the enshrinement rites.

sentences.zh: 五年九月，晟與侍中馬燧見於延英殿，上嘉其勛力，詔曰：「昔我列祖，乘乾坤之蕩滌，掃隋季之荒屯，體元禦極，作人父母；

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year Sheng and Palace Director Ma Sui were received at Yanying Hall. The emperor praised their merit and issued an edict: "Of old my successive ancestors, riding heaven and earth's cleansing flood, swept away the Sui dynasty's wild entanglement, embodying the primal and ascending to the supreme, became parents to the people;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fifth year Sheng and Palace Director Ma Sui were received at Yanying Hall. The emperor praised their merit and issued an edict: "Of old my successive ancestors, riding heaven and earth's cleansing flood, swept away the Sui dynasty's wild entanglement, embodying the primal and ascending to the supreme, became parents to the people;

sentences.zh: 則亦有熊羆之士，不二心之臣，左右經綸，參翊締構，昭文德，恢武功，威不若，康不乂，用端命於上帝，付畀四方。

translations.literal: then also were bear-and-badger warriors, loyal heart-undivided ministers, who at left and right wove the fabric of state, jointly aiding foundation and structure, displaying civil virtue, expanding martial achievement, where wrongdoing had no foothold and peace had no disorder, thereby receiving pure mandate from the High God and entrusting the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: then also were bear-and-badger warriors, loyal heart-undivided ministers, who at left and right wove the fabric of state, jointly aiding foundation and structure, displaying civil virtue, expanding martial achievement, where wrongdoing had no foothold and peace had no disorder, thereby receiving pure mandate from the High God and entrusting the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 宇宙既清，日月既貞，王業既成，太階既平；

translations.literal: When cosmos was clear, sun and moon settled, royal enterprise achieved, and the Grand Stairway level;
translations.idiomatic: When cosmos was clear, sun and moon settled, royal enterprise achieved, and the Grand Stairway level;

sentences.zh: 乃圖厥容，列於斯閣，懋昭績效，式表儀形，一以不忘於朝夕，一以永垂乎來裔，君臣之義，厚莫重焉。

translations.literal: then their images were painted and placed in this pavilion, richly displaying their achievement, formally showing their likenesses—one copy to never forget from morning to evening, one to eternally extend to coming generations. The meaning between ruler and minister—nothing is heavier.
translations.idiomatic: then their images were painted and placed in this pavilion, richly displaying their achievement, formally showing their likenesses—one copy to never forget from morning to evening, one to eternally extend to coming generations. The meaning between ruler and minister—nothing is heavier.

sentences.zh: 貞元己巳歲秋九月，我行西宮，瞻宏閣崇構，見老臣遺象，颙然肅然，和敬在色，想雲龍之葉應，感致來之艱難。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn in the jisi year of Zhenyuan, I walked the Western Palace, gazed at the great pavilion's lofty structure, saw the surviving images of old ministers—solemn and reverent, harmony and respect on their faces. I thought of cloud-and-dragon mutual response and felt the hardship of how we arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn in the jisi year of Zhenyuan, I walked the Western Palace, gazed at the great pavilion's lofty structure, saw the surviving images of old ministers—solemn and reverent, harmony and respect on their faces. I thought of cloud-and-dragon mutual response and felt the hardship of how we arrived.

sentences.zh: 睹往思今，取類非遠。

translations.literal: Seeing the past, thinking of the present—the parallel is not far.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the past, thinking of the present—the parallel is not far.

sentences.zh: 且功與時並，才為代生，茍蘊其才，遇其時，尊主庇人，何代不有？

translations.literal: Moreover merit rises with the age, talent is born for the era. If one holds talent and meets the time, honoring the lord and sheltering the people—what age lacks this?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover merit rises with the age, talent is born for the era. If one holds talent and meets the time, honoring the lord and sheltering the people—what age lacks this?

sentences.zh: 在中宗，則桓彥範等著其輔戴之績；

translations.literal: Under Zhongzong, Huan Yanfan and others left their merit in assisting and supporting.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhongzong, Huan Yanfan and others left their merit in assisting and supporting.

sentences.zh: 在玄宗，則劉幽求等申翼奉之勛；

translations.literal: Under Xuanzong, Liu Youqiu and others displayed their merit in winging and serving.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xuanzong, Liu Youqiu and others displayed their merit in winging and serving.

sentences.zh: 在肅宗，則郭子儀掃殄氛昆；

translations.literal: Under Suzong, Guo Ziyi swept away the evil miasma;
translations.idiomatic: Under Suzong, Guo Ziyi swept away the evil miasma;

sentences.zh: 今則李晟等保寧朕躬。

translations.literal: now Li Sheng and others preserved and secured my person.
translations.idiomatic: now Li Sheng and others preserved and secured my person.

sentences.zh: 咸宣力肆勤，光復宗社。

translations.literal: All declared strength and poured out diligence, brilliantly restoring the ancestral altars.
translations.idiomatic: All declared strength and poured out diligence, brilliantly restoring the ancestral altars.

sentences.zh: 訂之前烈，夫豈多謝，闕而未錄，孰謂旌賢。

translations.literal: Compared with former worthies, how could we over-praise? Yet left out and unrecorded—who would call that honoring the worthy?
translations.idiomatic: Compared with former worthies, how could we over-praise? Yet left out and unrecorded—who would call that honoring the worthy?

sentences.zh: 況念功紀德，文祖所為也，在予曷其敢怠！

translations.literal: Moreover to remember merit and record virtue is what Wen Zu did. How would I dare be slack!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover to remember merit and record virtue is what Wen Zu did. How would I dare be slack!

sentences.zh: 有司宜敘年代先後，各圖其像於舊臣之次，仍令皇太子書朕是命，紀於壁焉。

translations.literal: The relevant offices should order by era, place each portrait in sequence among old ministers, and still have the Crown Prince write this command of mine, recording it on the wall.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices should order by era, place each portrait in sequence among old ministers, and still have the Crown Prince write this command of mine, recording it on the wall.

sentences.zh: 庶播嘉庸，式昭於下，俾後來者尚揖清顏，知元勛之不朽。」

translations.literal: Thus may fine achievement be spread and brilliantly displayed below, so that those who come after may still bow before clear countenances and know that founding merit is imperishable."
translations.idiomatic: Thus may fine achievement be spread and brilliantly displayed below, so that those who come after may still bow before clear countenances and know that founding merit is imperishable."

sentences.zh: 復命皇太子書其文以賜晟，晟刻石於門左。

translations.literal: He again ordered the Crown Prince to write the text and grant it to Sheng. Sheng had it carved in stone at the left of his gate.
translations.idiomatic: He again ordered the Crown Prince to write the text and grant it to Sheng. Sheng had it carved in stone at the left of his gate.

sentences.zh: 初，晟在鳳翔，謂賓介曰：「魏征能直言極諫，致太宗於堯、舜之上，真忠臣也，仆所慕之。」

translations.literal: Earlier, when Sheng was at Fengxiang, he told guests and aides: "Wei Zheng could speak bluntly and remonstrate to the limit, raising Taizong above Yao and Shun—truly a loyal minister. That is what I admire."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Sheng was at Fengxiang, he told guests and aides, "Wei Zheng could speak bluntly and remonstrate to the limit, raising Taizong above Yao and Shun—truly a loyal minister. That is what I admire."

sentences.zh: 行軍司馬李叔度對曰：「此搢紳儒者之事，非勛德所宜。」

translations.literal: March Commander Li Shudu replied: "That is the affair of gentry scholars. It is not fitting for one of martial merit."
translations.idiomatic: March Commander Li Shudu replied, "That is the affair of gentry scholars. It is not fitting for one of martial merit."

sentences.zh: 晟斂容曰：「行軍失言。」

translations.literal: Sheng composed his expression and said: "Commander, you misspoke."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng composed his expression and said, "Commander, you misspoke."

sentences.zh: 「傳稱『邦有道，危言危行』。

translations.literal: "The tradition says, 'When the state has the Way, speak perilous words and walk perilous paths.'
translations.idiomatic: "The tradition says, 'When the state has the Way, speak perilous words and walk perilous paths.'

sentences.zh: 今休明之期，晟幸得備位將相，心有不可，忍而不言，豈可謂有犯無隱，知無不為者耶！

translations.literal: Now in this era of radiant glory, Sheng fortunately holds the post of general and chancellor. When the heart finds something unacceptable, to bear it and not speak—how can that be called one who speaks without concealment when there is offense, who acts whenever he knows?
translations.idiomatic: Now in this era of radiant glory, Sheng fortunately holds the post of general and chancellor. When the heart finds something unacceptable, to bear it and not speak—how can that be called one who speaks without concealment when there is offense, who acts whenever he knows?

sentences.zh: 是非在人主所擇耳。」

translations.literal: Right and wrong are for the lord to choose."
translations.idiomatic: Right and wrong are for the lord to choose."

sentences.zh: 叔度慚而退。

translations.literal: Shudu withdrew in shame.
translations.idiomatic: Shudu withdrew in shame.

sentences.zh: 故晟為相，每當上所顧問，必極言匪躬。

translations.literal: Therefore when Sheng served as chancellor, whenever the emperor consulted him, he always spoke to the utmost without sparing himself.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when Sheng served as chancellor, whenever the emperor consulted him, he always spoke to the utmost without sparing himself.

sentences.zh: 盡大臣之節。

translations.literal: He fulfilled a great minister's integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He fulfilled a great minister's integrity.

sentences.zh: 性沈默，未嘗泄於所親。

translations.literal: By nature he was silent. He never disclosed secrets even to those close to him.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was silent. He never disclosed secrets even to those close to him.

sentences.zh: 臨下明察，每理軍，必曰某有勞，某能其事，雖廝養小善，必記姓名。

translations.literal: Toward subordinates he was perceptive. Whenever he administered the army he would say so-and-so has merit, so-and-so can handle the task. Even small kindnesses among menials he would note by name.
translations.idiomatic: Toward subordinates he was perceptive. Whenever he administered the army he would say so-and-so has merit, so-and-so can handle the task. Even small kindnesses among menials he would note by name.

sentences.zh: 尤惡下為朋黨相構，好善嫉惡，出於天性。

translations.literal: He especially hated subordinates forming factions against one another. Loving good and hating evil came from his inborn nature.
translations.idiomatic: He especially hated subordinates forming factions against one another. Loving good and hating evil came from his inborn nature.

sentences.zh: 嘗有恩者，厚報之。

translations.literal: When someone had done him a kindness, he repaid it generously.
translations.idiomatic: When someone had done him a kindness, he repaid it generously.

sentences.zh: 初，譚元澄為嵐州刺史，嘗有恩於晟，後坐貶於岳州；

translations.literal: Earlier Tan Yuancheng was Prefect of Lan Prefecture and had once shown kindness to Sheng. Later he was punished and demoted to Yue Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Tan Yuancheng was Prefect of Lan Prefecture and had once shown kindness to Sheng. Later he was punished and demoted to Yue Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 比晟貴，上疏理之，詔贈元澄寧州刺史。

translations.literal: When Sheng rose to eminence he submitted a memorial to clear him. An edict posthumously granted Yuancheng Prefect of Ning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng rose to eminence he submitted a memorial to clear him. An edict posthumously granted Yuancheng Prefect of Ning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元澄三子，晟撫待勤至，皆為成就宦學，人皆義之。

translations.literal: Yuancheng's three sons—Sheng raised and treated them with utmost diligence. All achieved official learning. People praised his righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Yuancheng's three sons—Sheng raised and treated them with utmost diligence. All achieved official learning. People praised his righteousness.

sentences.zh: 理家以嚴稱，諸子侄非晨昏不得謁見，言不及公事，視王氏甥如己子。

translations.literal: He governed his household with strictness. Sons and nephews could not visit except at dawn and dusk. Speech did not touch public affairs. He treated Lady Wang's nephews as his own sons.
translations.idiomatic: He governed his household with strictness. Sons and nephews could not visit except at dawn and dusk. Speech did not touch public affairs. He treated Lady Wang's nephews as his own sons.

sentences.zh: 嘗正歲，崔氏女歸省，未及階，晟卻之曰：「爾有家，況姑在堂，婦當奉酒醴從饋，以待賓客。」

translations.literal: Once at New Year a daughter of the Cui clan came home for a visit. Before she reached the steps Sheng turned her back saying: "You have your own household. Moreover your mother-in-law is present. A wife should offer wine and sweetmeats in attendance and wait on guests."
translations.idiomatic: Once at New Year a daughter of the Cui clan came home for a visit. Before she reached the steps Sheng turned her back saying, "You have your own household. Moreover your mother-in-law is present. A wife should offer wine and sweetmeats in attendance and wait on guests."

sentences.zh: 遂不視而遣還家，其達禮敦教如此。

translations.literal: He did not see her but sent her home. Such was his understanding of rites and earnest teaching.
translations.idiomatic: He did not see her but sent her home. Such was his understanding of rites and earnest teaching.

sentences.zh: 貞元九年八月薨，時年六十七。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the ninth year of Zhenyuan he died. He was sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the ninth year of Zhenyuan he died. He was sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 上震悼出涕，廢朝五日，令百官就第臨吊，命京兆尹李充監護喪事，官給葬具，赗賻加等。

translations.literal: The emperor was shocked and grieved, shedding tears. Court was suspended five days. He ordered the hundred officials to visit his residence to mourn. He commanded Jingzhao Prefect Li Chong to supervise funeral affairs. The government supplied burial goods and enhanced condolence gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was shocked and grieved, shedding tears. Court was suspended five days. He ordered the hundred officials to visit his residence to mourn. He commanded Jingzhao Prefect Li Chong to supervise funeral affairs. The government supplied burial goods and enhanced condolence gifts.

sentences.zh: 比大斂，上手書致意，送柩前，曰：

translations.literal: At the great encoffining the emperor personally wrote a message of regard and sent it before the coffin, saying:
translations.idiomatic: At the great encoffining the emperor personally wrote a message of regard and sent it before the coffin, saying:

sentences.zh: 皇帝遣宮闈令第五守進致旨於故太尉、中書令、西平郡王、贈太師之靈曰：「天祚我邦，是生才傑，稟陰陽之粹氣，實山嶽之降靈。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Palace Gate Commandant Diwushoujin to convey his message before the spirit of the late Grand Commandant, Palace Director, Prince of Xiping Commandery, posthumously Grand Preceptor: "Heaven blesses our state and thereby produces outstanding talent, bearing the pure breath of yin and yang, truly the descent of mountain and peak spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Palace Gate Commandant Diwushoujin to convey his message before the spirit of the late Grand Commandant, Palace Director, Prince of Xiping Commandery, posthumously Grand Preceptor: "Heaven blesses our state and thereby produces outstanding talent, bearing the pure breath of yin and yang, truly the descent of mountain and peak spirits.

sentences.zh: 弘濟患難，保佐王室：掃蕩氛昆，廓清上京。

translations.literal: Greatly relieving disaster and hardship, preserving and assisting the royal house: sweeping away evil miasma, clearing the upper capital.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly relieving disaster and hardship, preserving and assisting the royal house: sweeping away evil miasma, clearing the upper capital.

sentences.zh: 忠誠感於人神，功業施於社稷，匡時定亂，實賴元勛。

translations.literal: Loyalty moved human and divine hearts. Merit was applied to the altars of state. Correcting the age and settling chaos—truly we relied on founding merit.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty moved human and divine hearts. Merit was applied to the altars of state. Correcting the age and settling chaos—truly we relied on founding merit.

sentences.zh: 洎領上臺，克諧中外，訏謨帝道，葉贊皇猷。

translations.literal: When he took the highest offices, he harmonized inner and outer, counseled the imperial Way, jointly aiding the sovereign design.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the highest offices, he harmonized inner and outer, counseled the imperial Way, jointly aiding the sovereign design.

sentences.zh: 常竭嘉言，以匡不迨，情所親重，義無間然。

translations.literal: He constantly poured forth fine counsel to correct what was not yet attained. Feeling held him close, righteousness brooked no distance.
translations.idiomatic: He constantly poured forth fine counsel to correct what was not yet attained. Feeling held him close, righteousness brooked no distance.

sentences.zh: 方期與國同休，永為邦翰。

translations.literal: We had just expected to share the state's felicity with him forever, that he would eternally be the state's pillar.
translations.idiomatic: We had just expected to share the state's felicity with him forever, that he would eternally be the state's pillar.

sentences.zh: 比嬰疾恙，雖歷旬時，日冀痊除，重期相見，弼予在位，終致和平。

translations.literal: Recently he fell ill. Though weeks passed, day by day we hoped for recovery, again expecting to meet, that he would assist us on the throne and ultimately bring peace.
translations.idiomatic: Recently he fell ill. Though weeks passed, day by day we hoped for recovery, again expecting to meet, that he would assist us on the throne and ultimately bring peace.

sentences.zh: 豈圖藥餌無征，奄至薨逝，喪我賢哲，虧我股肱，天不慭遺，痛惜何極，嗚呼！

translations.literal: Who thought medicine would show no effect and sudden death would come! We have lost our wise sage, maimed our arms and legs. Heaven is unkind in withholding him. Grief and lament know no limit. Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Who thought medicine would show no effect and sudden death would come! We have lost our wise sage, maimed our arms and legs. Heaven is unkind in withholding him. Grief and lament know no limit. Alas!

sentences.zh: 大廈方構，旋失棟梁；

translations.literal: The great hall was just being built when suddenly we lost its beam and rafter;
translations.idiomatic: The great hall was just being built when suddenly we lost its beam and rafter;

sentences.zh: 巨川未濟，遂亡舟楫。

translations.literal: The great river was not yet crossed when suddenly we lost boat and oar.
translations.idiomatic: The great river was not yet crossed when suddenly we lost boat and oar.

sentences.zh: 君臣之義，追慟益深，循省遺章，倍增感切。

translations.literal: The meaning between ruler and minister—pursuing grief grows deeper. Following and reviewing his surviving writings, moved feeling doubles.
translations.idiomatic: The meaning between ruler and minister—pursuing grief grows deeper. Following and reviewing his surviving writings, moved feeling doubles.

sentences.zh: 卿一門胤嗣，朕必終始保持。

translations.literal: Your whole clan and descendants—I must from start to finish preserve them.
translations.idiomatic: Your whole clan and descendants—I must from start to finish preserve them.

sentences.zh: 況願等弟兄，承卿教訓，朕之誌義，豈忘平生？

translations.literal: Moreover your sons Yuan and their brothers, receiving your instruction—would my resolve and righteousness forget our lifelong bond?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover your sons Yuan and their brothers, receiving your instruction—would my resolve and righteousness forget our lifelong bond?

sentences.zh: 縱卿不言，朕亦存信。

translations.literal: Even had you not spoken, I still hold trust.
translations.idiomatic: Even had you not spoken, I still hold trust.

sentences.zh: 比者卿在之日，卻未見朕深心，今卿與朕長乖，方冀知朕誠誌。

translations.literal: Before, while you lived, you did not yet see my inmost heart. Now you and I are long parted—only then do I hope you know my sincere will.
translations.idiomatic: Before, while you lived, you did not yet see my inmost heart. Now you and I are long parted—only then do I hope you know my sincere will.

sentences.zh: 無以為念，發言涕零，是用躬述數行，貴寫所懷得盡。

translations.literal: Unable to bear the thought, my words come with streaming tears. Therefore I personally write these few lines, precious for expressing what I hold fully.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to bear the thought, my words come with streaming tears. Therefore I personally write these few lines, precious for expressing what I hold fully.

sentences.zh: 臨紙遣使，不能飾詞，魂而有知，當體朕意。」

translations.literal: Facing the paper I send a messenger. I cannot polish my words. If your soul has awareness, you should embrace my meaning."
translations.idiomatic: Facing the paper I send a messenger. I cannot polish my words. If your soul has awareness, you should embrace my meaning."

sentences.zh: 冊贈太師，謚曰忠武。

translations.literal: By patent he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor. His posthumous title was Zhongwu (Loyal and Martial).
translations.idiomatic: By patent he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor. His posthumous title was Zhongwu (Loyal and Martial).

sentences.zh: 晟薨後，城鹽州，復鹽池，上賜宰臣新鹽，惻然思晟，乃令致鹽於靈座。

translations.literal: After Sheng's death Yan Prefecture was fortified and salt pools restored. The emperor granted new salt to the chancellors. Moved with sorrow thinking of Sheng, he had salt sent to Sheng's spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: After Sheng's death Yan Prefecture was fortified and salt pools restored. The emperor granted new salt to the chancellors. Moved with sorrow thinking of Sheng, he had salt sent to Sheng's spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 又時遣中使至晟第存撫諸子，教戒備至，聞願等有一善，上喜形於色。

translations.literal: He also from time to time sent palace envoys to Sheng's residence to comfort his sons, instructing and warning them with full care. Hearing Yuan and the others had any virtue, the emperor's joy showed on his face.
translations.idiomatic: He also from time to time sent palace envoys to Sheng's residence to comfort his sons, instructing and warning them with full care. Hearing Yuan and the others had any virtue, the emperor's joy showed on his face.

sentences.zh: 眷遇終始，無與晟比。

translations.literal: Favor from start to finish—none compared with Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Favor from start to finish—none compared with Sheng.

sentences.zh: 元和四年，詔曰：「夫能定社稷，濟生人，存不朽之名，垂可久之業者，必報以殊常之寵，待以親比之恩，與國無窮，時惟茂典。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanhe an edict said: "One who can settle the altars of state, deliver the living, preserve an imperishable name, and hand down lasting enterprise must be repaid with extraordinary favor, treated with kinship-like grace, sharing the state's endless fortune—this is the flourishing precedent of the age.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yuanhe an edict said, "One who can settle the altars of state, deliver the living, preserve an imperishable name, and hand down lasting enterprise must be repaid with extraordinary favor, treated with kinship-like grace, sharing the state's endless fortune—this is the flourishing precedent of the age.

sentences.zh: 故奉天定難功臣、太尉、兼中書令、上柱國、西平郡王、食實封一千五百戶、贈太師李晟，間代英賢，自天忠義，邁濟時之宏算，抱經武之長材，貫以至誠，協於一德，嘗遭屯難之際，實著戡定之功。

translations.literal: Therefore the merit subject of Fengtian who settled crisis, Grand Commandant, concurrent Palace Director, Supreme Pillar of the State, Prince of Xiping Commandery, with fifteen hundred taxable households, posthumously Grand Preceptor Li Sheng—an heroic worthy of successive ages, loyal and righteous from heaven, surpassing the grand calculations of the age, embracing long talent in civil and martial arts, threaded through with utmost sincerity, harmonized in single virtue—once encountered the hour of bitter hardship and truly displayed the merit of conquering and settling.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the merit subject of Fengtian who settled crisis, Grand Commandant, concurrent Palace Director, Supreme Pillar of the State, Prince of Xiping Commandery, with fifteen hundred taxable households, posthumously Grand Preceptor Li Sheng—an heroic worthy of successive ages, loyal and righteous from heaven, surpassing the grand calculations of the age, embracing long talent in civil and martial arts, threaded through with utmost sincerity, harmonized in single virtue—once encountered the hour of bitter hardship and truly displayed the merit of conquering and settling.

sentences.zh: 鯨鯢既殲，宮廟斯復，眷茲勛伐，則既褒崇。

translations.literal: When the leviathan and whale were destroyed, the palace temples were restored. Mindful of this martial achievement, we have already honored and elevated him.
translations.idiomatic: When the leviathan and whale were destroyed, the palace temples were restored. Mindful of this martial achievement, we have already honored and elevated him.

sentences.zh: 永言天步之夷，載懷邦傑之功，思加崇於往烈，爰協比於後昆，睦以宗親，將予厚意。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of heaven's tread made smooth, bearing in mind the state's heroic merit, thinking to add further honor to former worthies, and thus unite in kinship with later generations, binding with clan relation, bestowing my deep favor.
translations.idiomatic: Ever speaking of heaven's tread made smooth, bearing in mind the state's heroic merit, thinking to add further honor to former worthies, and thus unite in kinship with later generations, binding with clan relation, bestowing my deep favor.

sentences.zh: 其家宜令編附屬籍。

translations.literal: His family should be registered in the imperial clan rolls.
translations.idiomatic: His family should be entered in the imperial clan rolls.

sentences.zh: 晟饗德宗廟庭。」

translations.literal: Li Sheng shall share sacrifice at Dezong's ancestral temple."
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng shall share sacrifice at Dezong's ancestral temple."

sentences.zh: 晟十五子：侗、伷、偕，無祿早世；

translations.literal: Sheng had fifteen sons: Tong, Zhou, and Xie died young without office;
translations.idiomatic: Sheng had fifteen sons: Tong, Zhou, and Xie died young without ever holding office;

sentences.zh: 次願、聰、總、愻、憑、恕、憲、愬、懿、聽、惎、慇，聰、總官卑而卒，而願、愬、聽最知名。

translations.literal: next came Yuan, Cong, Zong, Sun, Ping, Shu, Xian, Su, Yi, Ting, Ji, and Yin. Cong and Zong held low rank and died in office, while Yuan, Su, and Ting were the most renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Next came Yuan, Cong, Zong, Sun, Ping, Shu, Xian, Su, Yi, Ting, Ji, and Yin. Cong and Zong held low rank and died in office, but Yuan, Su, and Ting were the most renowned.

sentences.zh: 願，幼謙謹寡過，晟立大勛，諸子猶無官，宰相奏陳，德宗即日召願拜銀青光祿大夫、太子賓客、上柱國。

translations.literal: Yuan, from youth modest, careful, and seldom at fault, though Sheng had won great merit, his sons still held no office. The chief ministers memorialized on the matter, and Dezong that same day summoned Yuan and appointed him Silver-glow Grand Master of Golden Seal, Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent, and Supreme Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan had been modest and careful from youth and seldom erred. Though Sheng had won great merit, his sons still held no office. The chief ministers memorialized on the matter, and Dezong that same day summoned Yuan and appointed him Silver-glow Grand Master of Golden Seal, Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent, and Supreme Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 舊制，勛至上柱國，賜門戟，即令賜願，乃與父並列棨戟於門。

translations.literal: By old precedent, merit reaching Supreme Pillar of State brought halberds at the gate. The emperor at once granted them to Yuan, and father and son stood side by side with ceremonial halberds at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: By old precedent, merit reaching Supreme Pillar of State brought halberds at the gate. The emperor at once granted them to Yuan, and father and son stood side by side with ceremonial halberds at the gate.

sentences.zh: 九年，丁父憂。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he entered mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he entered mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 十二年，服闋，德宗召見願等於延英，憫然久之曰：「朕在宮中，常念卿等，追懷勛德，何日忘之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, when mourning ended, Dezong summoned Yuan and the others to the Hall of Extended Brilliance. After a long silence of pity he said, "When I was in the palace I often thought of you, remembering your father's merit—when did I ever forget it?
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when mourning ended, Dezong summoned Yuan and the others to the Hall of Extended Brilliance. After a long silence of pity he said, "When I was in the palace I often thought of you, remembering your father's merit—when did I ever forget it?

sentences.zh: 又聞卿等居喪得禮，朕甚嘉之。」

translations.literal: I also heard that you observed mourning properly, and I am greatly pleased."
translations.idiomatic: I also heard that you observed mourning properly, and I am greatly pleased."

sentences.zh: 各賜衣一襲、絹三千匹。

translations.literal: To each he granted one suit of clothing and three thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: To each he granted one suit of clothing and three thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 願依前授太子賓客，兄弟同日拜官者九人。

translations.literal: Yuan was again appointed Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent, and nine brothers received office on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was again appointed Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent, and nine brothers received office on the same day.

sentences.zh: 尋轉左衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to Senior General of the Left Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was transferred to Senior General of the Left Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 元和元年八月，檢校禮部尚書，兼夏州刺史、夏綏銀宥等州節度使，威令簡肅，甚得綏懷之術。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yuanhe he was made Acting Minister of Rites with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Xia Prefecture and military governor of Xia, Sui, Yin, You, and neighboring prefectures. His authority was concise and stern, and he mastered the art of pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Yuanhe he was made Acting Minister of Rites with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Xia Prefecture and military governor of Xia, Sui, Yin, You, and neighboring prefectures. His authority was concise and stern, and he mastered the art of pacification.

sentences.zh: 客有亡馬者，以狀告願，願以狀榜於路，懸金以購之。

translations.literal: A guest lost a horse and reported it to Yuan in writing. Yuan posted the report on the road and offered a reward in gold.
translations.idiomatic: A guest lost a horse and reported it to Yuan in writing. Yuan posted the report on the road and offered a reward in gold.

sentences.zh: 不三日，所亡馬系之榜下，仍置書一緘曰：「馬逸及群，不時告，罪當死，敢以良馬一匹贖罪，並亡馬謹納於路。」

translations.literal: Within three days the lost horse was tied beneath the notice, with a sealed letter saying, "The horse ran off with a herd and I did not report it in time. The crime deserves death. I dare offer a fine horse in ransom and return the lost horse to the road."
translations.idiomatic: Within three days the lost horse was tied beneath the notice, with a sealed letter saying, "The horse ran off with a herd and I did not report it in time. The crime deserves death. I dare offer a fine horse in ransom and return the lost horse to the road."

sentences.zh: 願付客亡馬而縱其良馬。

translations.literal: Yuan returned the lost horse to the guest and released the fine horse.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan returned the lost horse to the guest and released the fine horse.

sentences.zh: 境內嚴肅，多如此類。

translations.literal: Within his jurisdiction discipline was strict; many cases were like this.
translations.idiomatic: Within his jurisdiction discipline was strict; many cases were like this.

sentences.zh: 轉徐州刺史、武寧軍節度。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Prefect of Xu Prefecture and military governor of the Wuning Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Prefect of Xu Prefecture and military governor of the Wuning Army.

sentences.zh: 到鎮，以青、鄆不恭，奉命討伐，屠城下邑，捷奏屢聞。

translations.literal: On reaching his command he was ordered to punish Qing and Yan for their insubordination. He slaughtered cities and towns below the walls, and repeated reports of victory reached the court.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching his command he was ordered to punish Qing and Yan for their insubordination. He slaughtered cities and towns below the walls, and repeated reports of victory reached the court.

sentences.zh: 無何，有疾，以其弟愬代為徐帥，入為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Before long he fell ill. His brother Su replaced him as commander of Xu, and he entered the capital as Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he fell ill. His brother Su replaced him as commander of Xu, and he entered the capital as Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 疾愈，檢校尚書左僕射，兼鳳翔尹、鳳翔隴右節度使。

translations.literal: When his illness passed he was made Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Fengxiang and military governor of Fengxiang and Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness passed he was made Acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Fengxiang and military governor of Fengxiang and Longyou.

sentences.zh: 然自是頗怠於為理，無復素誌，聲色之外，全不介懷。

translations.literal: From then on he grew quite slack in governance and no longer kept his former resolve. Beyond music and women he cared for nothing at all.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he grew quite slack in governance and no longer kept his former resolve. Beyond music and women he cared for nothing at all.

sentences.zh: 長慶二年二月，檢校司空，兼汴州刺史、宣武軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Changqing he was made Acting Minister of Works with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Bian Prefecture and military governor of the Xuanwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Changqing he was made Acting Minister of Works with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Bian Prefecture and military governor of the Xuanwu Army.

sentences.zh: 先是，張弘靖為汴帥，以厚賞安士心。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhang Hongjing had been commander of Bian, he had used rich rewards to settle the troops' hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhang Hongjing had been commander of Bian, he had used rich rewards to settle the troops' hearts.

sentences.zh: 及願至，帑藏已竭，而願恣其奢侈，門內數百口，仰給官司，不恤軍政，賞賚不及弘靖時，而以威刑馭下。

translations.literal: When Yuan arrived the treasury was already empty, yet he indulged his extravagance. Several hundred mouths within his household lived off official supplies. He did not care for military affairs, and rewards fell short of Hongjing's day, while he ruled his men by harsh punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan arrived the treasury was already empty, yet he indulged his extravagance. Several hundred mouths within his household lived off official supplies. He did not care for military affairs, and rewards fell short of Hongjing's day, while he ruled his men by harsh punishment.

sentences.zh: 又令妻弟竇緩將親兵，緩亦驕傲黷貨，以是群情聚怨。

translations.literal: He also put his wife's younger brother Dou Huan in command of his personal troops. Huan too was arrogant and corrupt, and so resentment gathered among the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He also put his wife's younger brother Dou Huan in command of his personal troops. Huan too was arrogant and corrupt, and so resentment gathered among the ranks.

sentences.zh: 是歲七月四日夜，牙將李臣則、薛誌忠、秦鄰等三人宿直，突入竇緩帳中，斬緩首以徇。

translations.literal: That year, on the night of the fourth day of the seventh month, the guard officers Li Chenze, Xue Zhizhong, and Qin Lin were on night duty. They burst into Dou Huan's tent, cut off his head, and displayed it.
translations.idiomatic: That year, on the night of the fourth day of the seventh month, the guard officers Li Chenze, Xue Zhizhong, and Qin Lin were on night duty. They burst into Dou Huan's tent, cut off his head, and displayed it.

sentences.zh: 願聞有變，與左右數人露發而走，登子城北樓，懸縋而下，由水竇而出。

translations.literal: Yuan heard that trouble had broken out. With a few attendants he fled with hair loose, climbed the north tower of the inner city, lowered himself on a rope, and escaped through a water gate.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan heard that trouble had broken out. With a few attendants he fled with hair loose, climbed the north tower of the inner city, lowered himself on a rope, and escaped through a water gate.

sentences.zh: 比曉，行十數里，遇野人驅驢，奪而乘之，得至鄭州。

translations.literal: By dawn he had gone more than ten li and met a countryman driving a donkey. He seized it and rode, reaching Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn he had gone more than ten li and met a countryman driving a donkey. He seized it and rode, reaching Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 願妻竇氏死於亂兵之手，子三人匿而獲免，仆妾為軍士所俘。

translations.literal: Yuan's wife, Lady Dou, died at the hands of the mutinous soldiers. Three sons hid and escaped. Servants and concubines were taken by the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan's wife, Lady Dou, died at the hands of the mutinous soldiers. Three sons hid and escaped. Servants and concubines were taken by the troops.

sentences.zh: 城中大掠三日，乃立其牙將李為留後，以邀旄鉞，月余，方誅之。

translations.literal: Within the city there was great plunder for three days. The troops then set up their guard officer Li as acting commander and sought the imperial banner and axe. More than a month later he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Within the city there was great plunder for three days. The troops then set up their guard officer Li as acting commander and sought the imperial banner and axe. More than a month later he was executed.

sentences.zh: 願坐貶隨州刺史。

translations.literal: Yuan was demoted for his part to Prefect of Sui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was demoted for his part to Prefect of Sui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 朝廷念晟之勛，終不加罪，入為左金吾衛大將軍。

translations.literal: The court, mindful of Sheng's merit, never added further punishment. He entered the capital as Senior General of the Left Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The court, mindful of Sheng's merit, never added further punishment. He entered the capital as Senior General of the Left Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 長慶四年六月，復檢校司空，兼河中尹，充河中、晉、絳、慈、隰節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Changqing he was again made Acting Minister of Works with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Hezhong and military governor of Hezhong, Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Xi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Changqing he was again made Acting Minister of Works with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Hezhong and military governor of Hezhong, Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Xi.

sentences.zh: 河中之政，亦如岐、梁。

translations.literal: Government in Hezhong was like that in Qi and Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Government in Hezhong was like that in Qi and Liang.

sentences.zh: 加以願結托權幸，厚行賂遺，賦入隨盡，軍府蕭然，賴遽疾終，不爾，蒲人必有更變。

translations.literal: Moreover Yuan cultivated ties with the powerful and favored, lavished bribes, spent revenue as fast as it came in, and left the army headquarters bare. He died suddenly of illness; otherwise the people of Pu would surely have risen again.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Yuan cultivated ties with the powerful and favored, lavished bribes, spent revenue as fast as it came in, and left the army headquarters bare. He died suddenly of illness; otherwise the people of Pu would surely have risen again.

sentences.zh: 寶應元年六月卒，贈司徒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Baoying he died and was posthumously granted Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Baoying he died and was posthumously granted Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 愬以父廕起家，授太常寺協律郎，遷衛尉少卿。

translations.literal: Su began his career through his father's privilege, was appointed Harmonizing Officer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Su began his career through his father's privilege, was appointed Harmonizing Officer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 愬早喪所出，保養於晉國夫人王氏，及卒，晟以本非正室，令服緦，號哭不忍，晟感之，因許服缞。

translations.literal: Su lost his birth mother early and was raised by the Lady of Jin State, Wang. When she died, Sheng, because she had not been the principal wife, ordered him to wear the coarsest mourning. Su wept and could not bear it. Sheng was moved and therefore allowed him to wear the full mourning garb.
translations.idiomatic: Su lost his birth mother early and was raised by the Lady of Jin State, Wang. When she died, Sheng, because she had not been the principal wife, ordered him to wear the coarsest mourning. Su wept and could not bear it. Sheng was moved and therefore allowed him to wear the full mourning garb.

sentences.zh: 既練，丁父憂，愬與仲弟憲廬於墓側，德宗不許，詔令歸第。

translations.literal: When the mourning period of coarse cloth ended he entered mourning for his father. Su and his second younger brother Xian kept vigil in huts beside the tomb. Dezong would not allow it and ordered them to return home.
translations.idiomatic: When the mourning period of coarse cloth ended he entered mourning for his father. Su and his second younger brother Xian kept vigil in huts beside the tomb. Dezong would not allow it and ordered them to return home.

sentences.zh: 居一宿，徒跣復往，上知不可奪，遂許終制。

translations.literal: After one night he went back barefoot. The emperor saw he could not be turned aside and allowed him to complete the full mourning.
translations.idiomatic: After one night he went back barefoot. The emperor saw he could not be turned aside and allowed him to complete the full mourning.

sentences.zh: 服闋，授右庶子，轉少府監、左庶子。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed Right Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, then transferred to Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service and Left Subordinate of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was appointed Right Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, then transferred to Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service and Left Subordinate of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 出為坊、晉二州刺史。

translations.literal: He went out as Prefect of Fang and Jin Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Prefect of Fang and Jin Prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以理行殊異，加金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Because his governance was exceptionally good he was granted Golden-glow Grand Master of Golden Seal.
translations.idiomatic: Because his governance was exceptionally good he was granted Golden-glow Grand Master of Golden Seal.

sentences.zh: 復為庶子，累遷至太子詹事，宮苑閑廊使。

translations.literal: He returned as Subordinate of the Heir Apparent and rose in stages to Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent and Commissioner of the Palace Gardens and Idle Galleries.
translations.idiomatic: He returned as Subordinate of the Heir Apparent and rose in stages to Grand Mentor to the Heir Apparent and Commissioner of the Palace Gardens and Idle Galleries.

sentences.zh: 愬有籌略，善騎射。

translations.literal: Su had strategic talent and excelled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Su had strategic talent and excelled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 元和十一年，用兵討蔡州吳元濟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yuanhe troops were sent to attack Wu Yuanji of Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Yuanhe troops were sent to attack Wu Yuanji of Cai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月，唐鄧節度使高霞寓戰敗，又命袁滋為帥，滋亦無功。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Tang-Deng military governor Gao Xiayu was defeated in battle. Yuan Zi was then made commander, but he too achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tang-Deng military governor Gao Xiayu was defeated in battle. Yuan Zi was then made commander, but he too achieved nothing.

sentences.zh: 愬抗表自陳，願於軍前自效。

translations.literal: Su submitted a memorial resisting the tide and declaring himself, wishing to serve at the front on his own merit.
translations.idiomatic: Su submitted a memorial resisting the tide and declaring himself, wishing to serve at the front on his own merit.

sentences.zh: 宰相李逢吉亦以愬才可用，遂檢校左散騎常侍，兼鄧州刺史、御史大夫，充隨、唐、鄧節度使。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Li Fengji also judged Su's talent usable. Su was therefore made Acting Left Regular Attendant with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Deng Prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, and military governor of Sui, Tang, and Deng.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Li Fengji also judged Su's talent usable. Su was therefore made Acting Left Regular Attendant with concurrent appointment as Prefect of Deng Prefecture, Censor-in-Chief, and military governor of Sui, Tang, and Deng.

sentences.zh: 兵士摧敗之余，氣勢傷沮，愬揣知其情，乃不肅軍陣，不齊部伍。

translations.literal: The soldiers, fresh from defeat, were wounded in spirit and morale. Su read their mood and therefore did not drill the battle lines or align the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers, fresh from defeat, were wounded in spirit and morale. Su read their mood and therefore did not drill the battle lines or align the ranks.

sentences.zh: 或以不肅為言，愬曰：「賊方安袁尚書之寬易，吾不欲使其改備。」

translations.literal: Some spoke of the lack of discipline. Su said, "The bandits are at ease with Minister Yuan's leniency. I do not wish to make them change their guard."
translations.idiomatic: Some spoke of the lack of discipline. Su said, "The bandits are at ease with Minister Yuan's leniency. I do not wish to make them change their guard."

sentences.zh: 乃紿告三軍曰；

translations.literal: He then falsely announced to the whole army:
translations.idiomatic: He then falsely announced to the whole army:

sentences.zh: 「天子知愬柔而忍恥，故令撫養爾輩。

translations.literal: "The Son of Heaven knows Su is gentle and can bear shame, and therefore sent me to nurture you.
translations.idiomatic: "The Son of Heaven knows Su is gentle and can bear shame, and therefore sent me to nurture you.

sentences.zh: 戰者，非吾事也。」

translations.literal: Fighting is not my affair."
translations.idiomatic: Fighting is not my affair."

sentences.zh: 軍眾信而樂之。

translations.literal: The troops believed him and were pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The troops believed him and were pleased.

sentences.zh: 愬又散其優樂，未嘗宴樂，士卒傷痍者，親自撫之。

translations.literal: Su also dismissed his entertainers and never held feasts. He personally tended the wounded soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Su also dismissed his entertainers and never held feasts. He personally tended the wounded soldiers.

sentences.zh: 賊以嘗敗高、袁二帥，又以愬名位非所畏憚者，不甚增其備。

translations.literal: The bandits, having once defeated the two commanders Gao and Yuan, and seeing that Su's name and rank were not men they feared, did not greatly increase their guard.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits, having once defeated the two commanders Gao and Yuan, and seeing that Su's name and rank were not men they feared, did not greatly increase their guard.

sentences.zh: 愬沈勇長算，推誠待士，故能用其卑弱之勢，出賊不意。

translations.literal: Su was deep, brave, and far-sighted. He treated his men with sincerity and therefore could use his weak position to strike where the enemy did not expect.
translations.idiomatic: Su was deep, brave, and far-sighted. He treated his men with sincerity and therefore could use his weak position to strike where the enemy did not expect.

sentences.zh: 居半歲，知人可用，乃謀襲蔡，表請濟師。

translations.literal: After half a year he knew whom he could use and then planned a raid on Cai. He memorialized asking for reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: After half a year he knew whom he could use and then planned a raid on Cai. He memorialized asking for reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 詔河中、鄜坊騎兵二千人益之，由是完緝器械，陰計戎事。

translations.literal: An edict added two thousand cavalry from Hezhong and Zhenfang. Thereupon he completed weapons and secretly planned the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict added two thousand cavalry from Hezhong and Zhenfang. Thereupon he completed weapons and secretly planned the campaign.

sentences.zh: 嘗獲賊將丁士良，召入與語，辭氣不撓，愬異之，因釋其縛，置為捉生將。

translations.literal: He once captured the bandit general Ding Shiliang, summoned him to talk, and found his bearing unbroken. Su was struck by this, released his bonds, and made him a scout-captain.
translations.idiomatic: He once captured the bandit general Ding Shiliang, summoned him to talk, and found his bearing unbroken. Su was struck by this, released his bonds, and made him a scout-captain.

sentences.zh: 士良感之，乃曰：「賊將吳秀琳總眾數千，不可遽破者，用陳光洽之謀也。

translations.literal: Shiliang was moved and said, "The bandit general Wu Xiulin commands several thousand men and cannot be quickly broken because he uses Chen Guangqia's plans.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang was moved and said, "The bandit general Wu Xiulin commands several thousand men and cannot be quickly broken because he uses Chen Guangqia's plans.

sentences.zh: 士良能擒光洽以降秀琳。」

translations.literal: Shiliang can capture Guangqia and so bring Xiulin to surrender."
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang can capture Guangqia and so bring Xiulin to surrender."

sentences.zh: 愬從之，果擒光洽。

translations.literal: Su followed this and indeed captured Guangqia.
translations.idiomatic: Su followed this and indeed captured Guangqia.

sentences.zh: 十二月，吳秀琳以文成柵兵三千降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Wu Xiulin surrendered with three thousand men from the Wencheng stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wu Xiulin surrendered with three thousand men from the Wencheng stockade.

sentences.zh: 醖乃徑徙之新興柵，遂以秀琳之眾攻吳房縣，收其外城。

translations.literal: Su then moved them directly to the Xinxing stockade and used Xiulin's troops to attack Wu Fang County and take its outer wall.
translations.idiomatic: Su then moved them directly to the Xinxing stockade and used Xiulin's troops to attack Wu Fang County and take its outer wall.

sentences.zh: 初，將攻吳房，軍吏曰：「往亡日，請避之。」

translations.literal: When they were first to attack Wu Fang, an army officer said, "Today is a day of past flight. Please avoid it."
translations.idiomatic: When they were first to attack Wu Fang, an army officer said, "Today is a day of past flight. Please avoid it."

sentences.zh: 愬曰：「賊以往亡謂吾不來，正可擊也。」

translations.literal: Su said, "The bandits will think that because it is a day of past flight we will not come. That is exactly when we should strike."
translations.idiomatic: Su said, "The bandits will think that because it is a day of past flight we will not come. That is exactly when we should strike."

sentences.zh: 及戰，勝捷而歸。

translations.literal: In battle they won and returned in triumph.
translations.idiomatic: In battle they won and returned in triumph.

sentences.zh: 賊以驍騎五百追愬，愬下馬據胡床，令眾悉力赴戰，射殺賊將孫忠憲，乃退。

translations.literal: The bandits sent five hundred fierce horsemen in pursuit. Su dismounted, sat on a folding stool, ordered all to fight with full strength, shot dead the bandit general Sun Zhongxian, and then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits sent five hundred fierce horsemen in pursuit. Su dismounted, sat on a folding stool, ordered all to fight with full strength, shot dead the bandit general Sun Zhongxian, and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 或勸愬遂拔吳房，愬曰：「取之則合勢而固其穴，不如留之以分其力。」

translations.literal: Some urged Su to take Wu Fang at once. Su said, "If we take it the enemy will combine strength and fortify their nest. Better to leave it and divide their force."
translations.idiomatic: Some urged Su to take Wu Fang at once. Su said, "If we take it the enemy will combine strength and fortify their nest. Better to leave it and divide their force."

sentences.zh: 初，吳秀琳之降，愬單騎至柵下與之語，親釋其縛，署為衙將。

translations.literal: When Wu Xiulin first surrendered, Su rode alone to the stockade and spoke with him, personally releasing his bonds and appointing him a guard officer.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Xiulin first surrendered, Su rode alone to the stockade and spoke with him, personally releasing his bonds and appointing him a guard officer.

sentences.zh: 秀琳感恩，期於效報，謂愬曰：「若欲破賊，須得李祐，某無能為也。」

translations.literal: Xiulin was grateful and pledged to repay him. He said to Su, "If you wish to break the bandits you must get Li You. I can do nothing beyond that."
translations.idiomatic: Xiulin was grateful and pledged to repay him. He said to Su, "If you wish to break the bandits you must get Li You. I can do nothing beyond that."

sentences.zh: 祐者，賊之騎將，有膽略，守興橋柵，常侮易官軍，去來不可備。

translations.literal: You was a bandit cavalry commander, bold and resourceful, holding the Xingqiao stockade. He often treated the imperial army with contempt and came and went beyond guard.
translations.idiomatic: You was a bandit cavalry commander, bold and resourceful, holding the Xingqiao stockade. He often treated the imperial army with contempt and came and went beyond guard.

sentences.zh: 愬召其將史用誠誡之曰：「今祐以眾獲麥於張柴，爾可以三百騎伏旁林中，又使搖旆於前，示將焚麥者。

translations.literal: Su summoned his officer Shi Yongcheng and warned him, "Now You is harvesting wheat at Zhangchai with his force. You can hide three hundred horsemen in the woods nearby and have banners waved in front to show you mean to burn the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: Su summoned his officer Shi Yongcheng and warned him, "Now You is harvesting wheat at Zhangchai with his force. You can hide three hundred horsemen in the woods nearby and have banners waved in front to show you mean to burn the wheat.

sentences.zh: 祐素易我軍，必輕而來逐，爾以輕騎搏之，必獲祐。」

translations.literal: You has always despised our army. He will surely come lightly in pursuit. With light horsemen you can seize him and you will certainly capture You."
translations.idiomatic: You has always despised our army. He will surely come lightly in pursuit. With light horsemen you can seize him and you will certainly capture You."

sentences.zh: 用誠等如其料，果擒祐而還。

translations.literal: Yongcheng and the others did as he foresaw and indeed captured You and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yongcheng and the others did as he foresaw and indeed captured You and returned.

sentences.zh: 官軍常苦祐，皆請殺之，愬不聽，解縛而客禮之。

translations.literal: The imperial army had long suffered from You, and all asked that he be killed. Su would not listen. He released his bonds and received him as a guest.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial army had long suffered from You, and all asked that he be killed. Su would not listen. He released his bonds and received him as a guest.

sentences.zh: 愬乘間常召祐及李忠義，屏人而語，或至夜分。

translations.literal: Su often summoned You and Li Zhongyi when he found a moment, dismissed attendants, and spoke with them, sometimes until midnight.
translations.idiomatic: Su often summoned You and Li Zhongyi when he found a moment, dismissed attendants, and spoke with them, sometimes until midnight.

sentences.zh: 忠義，亦降將也，本名憲，愬致之。

translations.literal: Zhongyi too was a surrendered general. His original name was Xian, and Su had won him over.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyi too was a surrendered general. His original name was Xian, and Su had won him over.

sentences.zh: 軍中多諫愬，愬益寵祐。

translations.literal: Many in the army remonstrated with Su, and Su favored You all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Many in the army remonstrated with Su, and Su favored You all the more.

sentences.zh: 始募敢死者三千人以為突將，醖自教習之。

translations.literal: He first recruited three thousand dare-to-die men as shock troops, and Su personally trained them.
translations.idiomatic: He first recruited three thousand dare-to-die men as shock troops, and Su personally trained them.

sentences.zh: 愬將襲元濟，會雨水，自五月至七月不止，溝塍潰溢，不可出師。

translations.literal: Su was about to raid Yuanji when rain fell from the fifth month to the seventh without stopping. Ditches and embankments burst and overflowed, and troops could not march.
translations.idiomatic: Su was about to raid Yuanji when rain fell from the fifth month to the seventh without stopping. Ditches and embankments burst and overflowed, and troops could not march.

sentences.zh: 軍吏鹹以不殺祐為言，簡翰日至，且言得賊諜者具言其事。

translations.literal: Army officers all spoke of not killing You. Brief reports arrived daily, and they said captured bandit spies had fully reported the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Army officers all spoke of not killing You. Brief reports arrived daily, and they said captured bandit spies had fully reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 愬無以止之，乃持祐泣曰：「豈天意不欲平此賊，何爾一身見奪於眾口！」

translations.literal: Su had no way to stop them. He took You by the hand and wept, saying, "Can it be that Heaven does not wish these bandits pacified, that your single person should be torn away by the crowd!"
translations.idiomatic: Su had no way to stop them. He took You by the hand and wept, saying, "Can it be that Heaven does not wish these bandits pacified, that your single person should be torn away by the crowd!"

sentences.zh: 愬又慮諸軍先以謗聞，則不能全祐，乃械送京師，先表請釋，且言：「必殺祐，則無以成功者。」

translations.literal: Su also feared that if the armies sent slander first he could not save You whole. He sent You to the capital in fetters, memorializing first to have him released and saying, "If You must be killed, there will be no success."
translations.idiomatic: Su also feared that if the armies sent slander first he could not save You whole. He sent You to the capital in fetters, memorializing first to have him released and saying, "If You must be killed, there will be no success."

sentences.zh: 比祐至京，詔釋以還愬，乃署為散兵馬使，令佩刀巡警，出入帳中，略無猜閑。

translations.literal: When You reached the capital an edict released him and sent him back to Su. Su appointed him loose-cavalry commander, had him carry a sword on patrol, and enter and leave the tent without the least suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: When You reached the capital an edict released him and sent him back to Su. Su appointed him loose-cavalry commander, had him carry a sword on patrol, and enter and leave the tent without the least suspicion.

sentences.zh: 又改為六院兵馬使。

translations.literal: He was later made commander of the six-corps cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was later made commander of the six-corps cavalry.

sentences.zh: 舊軍令，有舍賊諜者屠其家，愬除其令，因使厚之，諜反以情告愬，愬益知賊中虛實。
